text: 💚 This App Helped Me Find Myself Again — I honestly don’t know where I’d be today without Reframe.  I joined Reframe in October 2024 because I knew I needed to change my relationship with alcohol. Like many people, I didn’t get it right the first time. But one thing I never did was give up. Reframe never gave up on me either.  What I found was so much more than an alcohol-free app. I found education, compassion, accountability, and a community that truly understands.  The coaches, the daily meetings, the science-based approach, and the incredible community kept cheering me on until I was finally strong enough to cheer myself on. That belief, support, and encouragement made all the difference.  Reframe has helped me change the way I think—not just about alcohol, but about myself. I’ve learned that cravings pass, emotions aren’t emergencies, and self-care isn’t selfish. I’ve learned to pause, breathe, and respond instead of react. Those lessons have changed every part of my life.  Today, I’m approaching five months alcohol-free, and for the first time in a very long time, I feel proud of myself. I’m more present with my family, more patient with myself, and more grateful than I ever imagined I could be. Recovery hasn’t made my life perfect, but it has made me capable of handling life’s challenges without reaching for a drink.  One of the greatest gifts has been the friendships I’ve made along the way. Encouraging others in the community has become just as meaningful as receiving encouragement myself. It’s amazing how people you’ve never met can help change your life.  If you’re wondering whether Reframe is worth trying, my answer is an emphatic yes. It isn’t magic, and it still takes commitment, but you don’t have to do it alone. Every small step matters, and every day you keep showing up is a victory.  Joining Reframe is one of the best decisions I’ve ever made. It didn’t just help me stop drinking—it helped me start finding myself again.  Today, I don’t just wake up grateful to be alcohol-free. I wake up grateful to be fully present for my life. That’s a gift Reframe helped me discover, and one I’ll never take for granted.

text: Life Changing!! — I have been a member of Reframe since Dec. 2021. This app has changed my life. While my journey has not been linear, Reframe has always offered the tools and options to help me in a non-judgmental, compassionate way. Everyone in the community is extremely supportive, and the Reframe administrative team has been exceptional at making sure this sense of acceptance and safety remains true at all times. I believe the biggest strength is that it is a science-based approach to what addiction really is. And you have a choice of paths- you can choose to be alcohol free or to mindfully moderat/cut back. This gives you the agency that so many of us need to actually affect change. And there is SOOO much to the app. The daily tasks include a robust set of short, information filled readings, followed by a thoughtful journal prompt that helps build your knowledge as you move through the process of changing your relationship with alcohol. It is filled with a plethora of other tools to provide support. The forum allows you to share your thoughts and experiences which are then supported by others. The multiple daily zoom meetings are incredibly powerful. There are tools to use when you have a craving, goal trackers, book and podcast recommendations, and the opportunity for personal coaching. There are monthly challenges that allow you to join with a small group of others to cheer and support one another. But I would say the most  powerful/impactful thing about Reframe is that you have an entire toolbox and community of real supportive, compassionate friends in your pocket at all times. Some might balk at the cost, but if you truly calculate how much you spend on alcohol in a single month, Reframe is a bargain-- and will SAVE you money as you also improve both your physical health! They say the opposite of addiction is connection, and Reframe is THAT connection.

I have a therapist that’s helped me through so much, but this was a private matter that Reframe helped me more than therapy was able to. I am now in a much better place with my drinking and therefore having a better relationship with myself and my friends/family. I feel better knowing reframe is there if I ever find myself wanting that support again. Get the app, do the challenges, do the work and you’ll thank yourself ❤️
author: Tar41007

text: Triple charged — Super surprised to fine three charges for this app on the same day from signing up for this app.  Two at intro rate and one at full rate.  Watch your credit cards with this app/company.
author: Chmbruin

text: Love this app! — I love this app! I have recommended it to others and patients who want to be more mindful of their alcohol use too! Helps you to cultivate increased awareness and be more mindful of your drinking (or for those going the sober route too). Provides positive reinforcement with badges, great personalized insights and overall nothing negative to say about the app at all. Highly recommend!
author: Adenise0309

text: It really is a great Reframe! — I’ve tried other apps and read/listened to many books. This app, although a bit pricey, has really helped in not only educating me on so many aspects associated with emotional, mental and physical health but also connecting with myself and others in a different light. This app moves along the journey with you without shame and with a deep understanding of what exactly I am going through based on MY daily check-ins. With the AI generated responses it’s so much more relatable and personalized to me and my lifestyle and situation. I’ve been tracking on Reframe for the month trial and decided to continue for the year because this app has been the most helpful of all the other apps/books etc that I’ve done. Do yourself a favor and at least try it for the free trial month. The app reminds you via email before the month is over so you can decide to continue or not before just getting hit with a charge at the end of the month. Good luck and happy Reframing!!
author: hapythts

text: This is bs — Listen, I keep seeing this app suggested to me on a lot of platforms and thought I would check it out. After an extremely long questionnaire, I get to the end and in order to sign up I need to pay for a subscription??? For $10 a month!?  What good does that do? If the creators really wanted to help people, it wouldn't cost $120 a year, it would be free. It's all algorithm based anyways. Absolutely ridiculous!
author: Tehyuhhh

text: Extremely Helpful — I have been using this app for almost 3 years. It has been so helpful to learn about the science of habit change and how the brain and body are affected by alcohol. That’s only the beginning of it, there’s a great drink and mood tracker, daily lessons, challenges each month, groups to join with others on the same path as you. Also coaching if you need to get extra support. I’m finally where I want to be with my drinking and I’ll continue to use this app for its support and great content that keeps being created.
author: Sofieah

text: Seems promising, ultimately a cash grab — The first 10 minutes seem very promising considering the questions it asks you. You gain a sense of security with the way it navigates your mind. At the end of all of that, you’ll feel like you got the help you wanted until they ask you for $100 a month. Absolutely disgusting to manipulate an addict for monetary gain.
author: K.ENSHIN

text: Sobering Truth — Reframe really aided me me with my decision to make a change in my drinking. The science and nonjudgmental approach really helped me. The encouragement and tools have proved very helpful.   Thanks
author: Soberbychoice

text: So much more than an app — Not only is Reframe ‘as advertised’ it is better! I’ve met so many people living healthy and happy without alcohol on this app. It’s fun; I highly recommend trying it if you are questioning your relationship with alcohol.
author: watchingthewheels

text: Choose 7 day free and it billed me for the year — Downloaded the app as I used tried it before a while ago. It prompted me for a 7 day free trial, choose it as it said I could try it and would only be billed after 7 days. It billed me immediately.
author: Decarlod

text: Worthless and expensive — The app never advanced past the first day. It reminds me every day to complete daily tasks which don’t exist, since it’s stuck on the first day’s tasks which are all completed.  $69 for 6 months is an absolute ripoff because the app doesn’t work.  Customer support is useless.  They asked me for screenshots which I sent. They never replied.  I want my money back.
author: RonCem

text: Poor content, shady billing — The content is generic, repetitive and pseudoscientific (e.g., kefir milk may reduce alcohol cravings). A lot of the prompts are for you to do little journal entries which then disappear. Not sure how that helps or why it’s worth paying for. Also after free trial period they charged me for a full year then refused to refund me so I’m having to claw it back with the help of my bank.
author: shrimply_pibbles

text: First time user — As a first time user this app and forum has been super supportive and easy to navigate. It’s like the private Facebook for people to help each other stay the course and it is a safe space to share. Really liking the quick easy tasks that hit all angles of reasons for quitting.
author: Awesome Autumn A

text: Reframe saves my life! — Sounds extreme but it is true. i’m been questioning my relationship with alcohol for many years. I’ve tried many different ways to quit or cut back one lucky day Instagram’s algorithm pushed the Reframe app onto my feed. Reframe offered away to not quit completely, but cut back. This was tempting as I was in 100% sure that I wanted completely. However, I definitely needed to cut back in order to improve my health and my life. It was gonna teach me all about drinking and what it does to my body. It was going to offer me tasks to do every day to keep me accountable. It also has distractions built into the app that will help me when I have cravings… These are all things I learned about it or neon and well worth trying out. What I didn’t know was that the app was gonna bring me a community of people that would help support me through my sobriety journey. has a chat feature built-in that’s available 24 seven where I can connect with people ask questions and get support. There are also daily zoom meetings, where people come to listen connect and share about their sobriety journey. Those meetings have become my livelihood. There are coaches in those meetings that help moderate offer feedback and support.  A few short weeks into my cut back journey with alcohol. I decided to switch to quit completely. I’m close to 500 days sober. I have a new lease on life and I have this app to thank for it and his amazing  coaches and community.
author: Soni-Jez

text: Super helpful and doesn’t take long out of your day. — I’ve been using this app for a month now and already noticed better sleep and mood quality within the first two weeks. It isn’t magic. It takes work but the short daily articles and journaling and friendly non-judgmental reminders help tremendously. Whether you’re cutting back or quitting drinking, it is a great tool to give a shot. Do the month trial for $5 if you’re hesitant like I was. It helps so much with approaching your habit from a different perspective. There’s so much mental work that goes into changing habits and this reminds you that you can always switch your approach and always evolve and better yourself with healthy alternatives and healthy mindset. The accountability is a huge factor. Checking in with every drink you might have really sets the tone with a mind and body connection. There is no blindly grabbing a drink and not thinking about it. It makes you evaluate if you really want or need that drink. Seeing how much money and empty calories you save on a daily basis really puts things into perspective. The little tips and insights help a lot and I’ve even used them to help loved ones going thorough hard times of their own. It isn’t about just drinking. It’s about learning healthy behaviors and unlearning old habits and that’s something everyone can take advantage of; not just people looking to quit or cut back on drinking.
author: The Rhage

text: New beginnings — I was stuck in a rut of daily drinking. I wanted to quit, but I couldn’t seem to put two sober days together in a row. I honestly felt like I would just try to get by that way, but my health was going downhill. Part of me really didn’t want to quit drinking. I heard about the Reframe app on social media and looked into it briefly and then kind of forgot about it. Then one weekend I saw it again on the social media and started looking into it. It was hard for me to read it out loud to my wife, but I was interested in it so I continued. I decided to sign up for 30 days and see what would happen. Out of the 30 days I only drank on 10 of those days. Right now, I am participating in sober October and very excited about it.  In a little over 30 days I have slept better at night, got rid of anxiety, lowered my blood pressure, lowered my cholesterol, and lost weight. I also have a better relationship with my wife and doing better at work because I’m sleeping better at night. I feel more focused and not feeling like I’m in a fog. I am happily surprised that I enjoy being sober and prefer being sober because I just feel so great now. I am going to continue with the Reframe app as I signed up for a year now. It is a great resource and if you’re on the fence about trying it out I say, just try it out. It’s working for me and that’s the truth.
author: ukeboy19

text: Game Changer — Over the years, since questioning my relationship with alcohol, I have done online sessions, schools, apps,etc to help me navigate my drinking. I have not wanted to fully quit but I have wanted to cut back. All things I had signed up for had some good stuff in it, but the reframe app has been by far the most amazing, helpful tool (for me) by far. I am absolutely obsessed with doing the daily tasks and learning things about my drinking I have never known or connected with (the science part of it). My favorite part of the app is that I can pop on any day of the week to the 30 min zoom calls for encouragement, support and ability to share my triumphs and downfalls with others who get it. There is zero shame and just so much love as we all navigate this together. The zoom leaders are absolutely awesome and so well spoken, educated on this subject and totally down to earth and relatable. I saw the app show up in my Instagram sponsored ads and kept seeing it but sat on it for quite some time. I finally decided to download it and can’t believe all that is available through it. I honestly can’t say enough about it. I’ve been doing it every day for 2 weeks straight. It’s become something I really look forward to and enjoy. Thank you sooooo much to the developers for creating this! You have been a godsend! 🙏🏻
author: Amy_444

text: Great App but Don’t Purchase the Coaching! — The app is fantastic for those recovering or on the journey to cut back and or to be alcohol free. Decent price at $40 annually. Great tools such as forums, multiple zoom check in sessions with coaches for those who need accountability, daily readings using scientific methods and analytics, podcasts, video libraries, courses, meditations, and much more. The biggest drawback is signing up for personalized coaching sessions which is $249 a month for 3 sessions. The coaches are certified coaches, no problem there. What isn’t clear when signing up is how the sessions work, there’s not enough terms explained. Such as you must use the sessions within the time frame you are charged or you loose them, they don’t carry over. What can be hard is that life can get in the way of scheduling those sessions especially during the holidays. I ran into this problem with my own schedule AND with the coach and her own schedule. Reframe also didn’t notify me via email to put the invite on my Google calendar so the coach had to notify Reframe to fix our schedules and that had happened to me and her other clients that week. Instead of charging a set # of sessions with in a month, you should be able to pay as you go for each session as it is in the real world when you schedule face to face therapy sessions. I was not happy that I lost out on my 3 unused sessions to Reframe.
author: ladymharris

text: Motivation and Support — Reframe has taken me from shame and desperation to an enthusiastic, informative and incredibly supportive, nonjudgmental and interactive exploration of my relationship with alcohol. Along with goals and trackers, there are options for personalized support groups and forums. Of special interest to me are the personalized group options. In three months I have shifted from sober curious to moderation and am now forty four days alcohol free. The decision just makes sense.  Especially fun and helpful is the option to connect with others in similar circumstances, even if their goals differ from mine. I joined both the Working Musicians and Sober in a Mountain Town (who even knew that was a thing?) groups. There are also daily virtual support groups I initially dropped in on without pressure to participate, or even turn on the microphone or video. I have gone from fly-on-the-wall to entering the chat thread. The accessibility allows me to carry my posse with me, on my phone, in the face of the seemingly perpetual free-alcohol and alcohol-heavy social scene presented by my work and relationships.   Finally, I have not, for one second regretted the investment I have made in myself. The cost for an entire year of basic involvement, which is the level I am presently on, is less than ten drinks (before a tip!) or an hour of counseling where I live. I am managing my relationship better and am moving from shame to pride in my decisions and accomplishments. I hope this review reeks of gratitude. Reframe won’t claim credit for success, but they can take full credit for encouraging me and providing me with resources and space to restore it in my life. Check it out and decide for yourself.
author: Love the Mountins

text: Reframe content & the app is amazing! — I was so doubtful when I downloaded this and really didn’t think I would benefit from it. But their first statement upfront is that if you don’t believe it can work, it won’t work for you. It’s a mindset. And I can tell you from buying the one year subscription 7 days ago, I already got my money’s worth. I was just trying to reduce my drinking and I haven’t had a drink in seven days. It’s because they teach so much about the impact on your brain and your organs in your body. It’s not about willpower or self-control. It’s about deciding to prioritize your health and well-being, your motivation and your ability to do more during the day. There’s no doomsday scare tactics, no shame, no judgment.  All of the content is so well put together and it varies every day and it’s customized to your personal goals. And they ask all of the right questions and give inspiration and challenges each morning.  I really find myself motivated by the community. Normally, I avoid forums and communities related to health care skin care because it’s a lot of the repeat. But this group is so inspiring and real, non-judgmental and in the fire with you. Thank you so much!
author: travelingfiend

text: Worked for a stubborn doctor — By my very nature, I tend to be a “go it alone”kinda guy. At 47 years old, that has worked great in some areas and been disastrous in others. I’m successful and well educated, and so I assumed I would be able to control alcohol on my own. I’m a doc. I know all the negative effects it has on my health. I have a family and I see the effects it has on them. I know how I feel after I’ve been drinking. That argh!!! I did it again feeling. This app has been a true life safer! I downloaded it at a low point when I was desperate for something. Anything. I’ve prayed till I was in tears that I could get my act together, and while I thought that would come by God giving me a miraculous desire to not want to drink, he didn’t. What he did give me was an iPhone. And an App Store. And an app named Reframe. Turns out that In my case, God wanted to use an app to help me do the work of getting my life under control. Turns out, God does work in ways that are not always of our understanding. I’ll be praying that someone might read this and that you will find it helpful in your journey. You got this!!! LETS GO!!!!
author: DenverbroncosPmac

text: Trust Me, Stick with Reframe and You'll See a Whole New Side to Your Relationship with Alcohol — Discovering the Reframe app has been a transformative experience for me. This isn't just an app; it's a lifeline to a community and a treasure trove of content that speaks directly to the heart of those seeking to change their relationship with alcohol. For so long, I believed that moderation was the key, but Reframe opened my eyes to the reality that for me, cutting back was not enough. The decision to stop completely was monumental, and it wouldn't have been possible without the invaluable insights and unwavering support I found through Reframe.  What sets Reframe apart is its holistic approach to sobriety. The app doesn't just focus on the act of stopping; it delves deep into the 'why' behind our behaviors, equipping us with the knowledge, strategies, and support to make lasting changes. The community aspect of Reframe is unparalleled. There's a genuine sense of belonging, an understanding that you're not navigating this journey alone. The encouragement and confidence I've received from fellow members have been instrumental in my ongoing commitment to sobriety.  Reframe is more than an app; it's a partner in recovery, offering a blend of compassion, science-based methods, and a judgment-free zone that fosters real, sustainable change. I only wish there were a similar app by the same developers focused on quitting vaping. The effectiveness and positive impact of Reframe have me convinced that such an app would be incredibly beneficial for those of us looking to conquer other habits. To anyone on the fence about trying Reframe, I cannot recommend it highly enough. It's not just about stopping; it's about finding a new way to live, and Reframe guides you through every step of that journey.
author: Sarah Key West

text: A Life Changer! — Initially I got this app to reduce drinking but now I realized how much better I feel when not drinking that I switched to alcohol free! My lab work is better than it has been my whole adult life and am much more productive as well as peaceful. What I love about this app is that they tell you the science behind the how your relationship with alcohol affects you. They don’t shame you at all and give plenty of positive reinforcement. I don’t feel guilty for not going on in a while (when I was drinking) because everyone is so supportive. The community is always encouraging and authentic. There are meetings via Zoom that you can just listen in on or type in the chat or share if you feel up to it! So far, I have only listened and typed in the chat but when people do share, only support and love is expressed. If you are thinking of cutting back or stopping entirely, I greatly recommend giving it the 7 day free trial and see how it goes. The subscription is so worth it. Paying for that is much less than I would have spent on alcohol in a few months. Hope to see you in the forum!
author: FishieFun

text: Mind blowing — I have never been an everyday drinker but lots of weekends and social events a binge drinker. I always had the nudging to let it go , to give up drinking, for the most part everything else in my life is pretty put together. When this app kept popping up on Instagram I decided to look in to it finally. I took the plunge for a month and halfway through the month signed up for the entire year. The coaches, the community, the teachings the bonds I am making with others really has been mind blowing to me. It is basically joining with others to share about our experiences and our journeys and supporting one another while’s learning the science behind alcohol. The meetings have been life saving in so many different aspects of my life. It teaches you how to cope with life on life’s terms. I would highly recommend this app to anyone. Thank you for the changes I have made in my life. I do know it comes down to the individual having to put in the work but with the love and support form this community it makes it so doable. 🙏❤️😘
author: (LittleTiny1) @jodi4kidz

text: Good Info, Inspirational, but sometimes — I started Reframe about five weeks ago. It offers real science and social science research as well as medical information. I find the information relevant and applicable. However, I joined as “sober curious” so I’ve not quit alcohol, but cutting back. So, Reframe’s positive feedback to a user still drinking isn't necessarily aligned with drinking, rather it is encouraging the user to keep completing Reframe’s daily tasks. I guess that positive feedback with no judgement is working because I do keep coming back every day. Plus, no reason to lie to myself or the app about still drinking, because there’s no judgement. Meanwhile, it does help you track how much you are drinking, when, where, and WHY! That’s the most important: the WHY. Now that I’ve used Reframe everyday—multiple times a day for certain tools and resources I’m discovering how much content Reframe. My buddies achievement so far, and it’s big for me, is mindfulness and letting go of self-shaming. I think that change, with the daily help from the Reframe app, will get me to where I truly want to be: conscious, controlled minimal drinker. Meaning, I want to allow myself to enjoy a holiday or congratulatory drink on occasion rather than a reactive drinker seeking to numb myself through stress and distress. My new morning routine is using Reframe the first 15-20 mins over a cup of coffee to frame my day with useful physical and mental information along with a self-inventory and some inspiration or encouragement to (re-)focus my attention to self-regulating through mindfulness (pause, assess, journal, meditate, stretch…simple things that grow in effectiveness the more you do them). And, I appreciate the nudges to complete the tasks. I am very grateful for this thoughtful, well designed app.
author: justramsey

text: My teeth and weight — I am only on my second week of achieving sobriety and the improvement in the quality of my life is immeasurable. Last night, for the first time, I was able to go down to the dock of our lake house drinking ice water and enjoying the evening while my husband was drinking alcohol.   The first 5 days were tough~ lots of negative symptoms: insomnia, restless leg syndrome in bed, constipation, dull headache, and overall restlessness. I’m still sleeping in the guest room, but actually slept the sleep of angels last night. I’m losing weight, swimming every day, and now waking up cheerful and full of energy. The best part of this journey is probably unique to me. I am no longer grinding my teeth at night. When I was drinking (more than I should every night since I retired), I would wake up every morning with my teeth and gums aching all day. My dentist warned me that I was critically injuring my enamel. I tried different mouth guards only to find them on the floor in the morning. Thank you Reframe; I’m not sure I could have done this without you.
author: Mainemags

text: It really works. — I was a daily drinker for 20+ years. I have tried to quit before and couldn’t do it. The combination of warnings from my doctor and using the Reframe app finally worked. Reframe worked for me because it logically and simply laid out the harm that I was doing to my brain, my heart, my health, my skin, etc. by drinking so much. That, combined with daily check-ins, educational and motivational topics, plus the Reframe Community.  I can’t say enough about how helpful the Reframe community is. In the beginning, I sought reassurance, but after a month or so, found myself giving reassurance and advice. It was incredibly empowering. I would read and respond to posts for up to an hour each night. I love the anonymity of it!  Those still suffering through the early days of not drinking reinforced my decision not to drink. Those who have been sober for a while inspired me. I’m so glad I found this app!  I now have more energy and more confidence. I’ve lost weight, my skin looks better and my blood pressure is down.
author: regnillo6

text: Reframe Works — Ok, another app. Another impulse. This app is  fantastic because it is neuroscience and not a set of rules that require you to be meek and remorseful, and instantly adhere to a religious dogma you may not agree with from the start. For skeptics like me, I have to get my feet wet before I will go in all the way. Reframe gives you  the option of how you want to define your relationship to alcohol use.  Are you cutting back or are you quitting? I really like this.  No shame. No guilt. By using the tool kit every day, I am going to spend 10 minutes learning about the physical effects of alcohol on the brain. Some chapters are about emotional response, triggers, impulses, and psychology. And there's one on one help or a forum if you need more support. It's been a terrific education, and my health and other habits have even improved. My relationship with alcohol has changed for the better. I am healthier, clearer-minded, and am living my best life.  I even got my brother to join and he's doing great. Thank you, Reframe.
author: halpiro

text: Super insightful & easy to do! — I’m not going to lie; I downloaded this app and waited probably two weeks before I even opened it and created a profile, and it probably took me another week and a half two weeks even to start using it. Definitely a slow go at first, but the more I used it, the more interested I was to use it. You learn so much about how your body and brain function and your own motivations to drink. Thankfully there’s not long journal that you have to do which is super helpful for me; I am not into the whole sit for an hour & pull out your childhood traumas kind of person. I love the Ted talks and all of the video information and little articles that they have that you can read. The mediations are great & inspiring as well. I like to listen to these in the am before / while getting ready for work. 100% recommend; this is a great way to analyze your relationship with alcohol & if you need more help or not. ✌🏼
author: Halehelene

text: LIFE CHANGER APP! — I love everything about this app, it’s brilliant! I wish I had this app 6 years ago. I’ve been wanting to cut back/give up alcohol for so long. I didn’t even know about this whole online sober community, but i am so glad it exists!   This app has been life changing for me, I downloaded it on a whim didn’t really know what to expect. I love that it talks about the neuroscience and psychology of alcohol. I’ve learned so much about how alcohol effects your mind and body, the whole science behind it. I HAD NO IDEA, that alcohol is an addictive drug. Society has normalized drinking. I love that this app helps hold you accountable. It has daily journal prompts, facts on alcohol, motivation quotes, recovery stories, coaching, and forums where you can connect with other people who are going thru the same thing!   I finally don’t feel alone and love that I’ve made so many connections in just the last month! I rave about this app to all my friends and family, even my therapist! It really is life changing and I look forward to this app every morning. I haven’t had a craving to drink for almost 40 days now and don’t plan on going back to it ever again. It was just what I needed to get sober and stay sober. I’ve taken breaks here and there but have always felt so lost and felt so judged or alone. Like I said this APP SAVED ME 🤩💖  Whether you’re sober curious, want to get sober or just want to learn more about alcohol and your relationship with alcohol, this is a great app! 10/10 highly recommend this app!! 🙌🏼
author: annnl10

text: Can’t recommend enough! — I don’t ever leave app reviews…ever lol. I’ll make an exception for this one though because it has immensely improved my life. What sets this sobriety app apart from the rest are the resources available to you and the ability to add drinks to your diary without resetting your start date. The latter specifically really helped me with the shame of a slip ups and allowed me to move forward without feeling like I was starting from the bottom again. You can tell that the creators of this really know how difficult it is to struggle with addiction by the care they put into this app. The community is great in the forum, you’ll have access to online check-ins/workshops, and guided meditations available for you when the cravings hit. The name of the app says it all. Reframe your mind and you’ll find peace. Thanks to the creators for this 🙏🏼🙏🏼 and if you’re struggling yourself, this one is 100% worth the purchase.
author: yaneck2254

text: Honestly wasn’t expecting this — I tried Reframe as a trial period. I never thought I needed therapy (I don’t cope well by talking to a stranger). And to be completely honest, I forgot about the trial period ending and was charged for a year. At first I was upset but decided to try out the app. I’m about 20 days in and think this is what I needed. Yes I still drink (my goal was never to quit completely) but the knowledge it gives you, along with the inspiration and actually explaining why we drink and ways to slow it down, is truthfully priceless. Not to mention it’s way cheaper than therapy. I’m not saying this is a substitute, some people need therapy. But for people like me who need a push in the right direction this is such a great app. I’m pretty sure there is support too to talk to people. I haven’t used it but the in app program they have set up is about as good as I could ask for. Well worth it for anyone thinking about it
author: Fred… Again & Again

text: Fantastic App to Reduce or Quit Alcohol! — This app has worked really well for me. I am currently on my longest dry streak in probably 20+ years. The lessons you learn help to change your view on drinking and make it that much easier to give it up (or reduce it if that’s your goal). The community is great as well. I have seen zero judgement from anyone - only genuine support and advice.  Do yourself a favor and get this app. It’ll more than pay for itself in the long run (case in point: I have saved about twice the amount of money I spent on getting the app by not buying alcohol anymore in just about 2 months).  This is also by no means only an app for hardcore alcoholics. Even if you’re just a regular person who looking to be a little healthier, this app can help you to reduce your drinking and doesn’t make you feel guilty or bad if you still drink alcohol and just want to work towards drinking a little less.
author: KimChilly

text: Group challenge — I just signed up for a 30 day trial. This is definitely new to me and I would like to see the  group challenge to have each individual have an occupation on their profile. This would help individuals in the same field or like-minded individuals relate and be better accountability buddies. being a part of somebody’s journey is important and to know the WHY behind this is even more of a reason why you’re accountability buddy is more valuable to your success because you can relate to each other. There are many reasons why each one of us on this app wants to give up alcohol and for me is improved health, mental clarity, better sleep, weight management, enhance, productivity, financial savings, and my biggest reason is personal growth. we already have one thing in common on this app and it’s alcohol and being sit free from it. I would definitely feel more comfortable finding somebody in the group challenge with the same background as Support.
author: SeyrRue

text: This one’s a keeper — I saw this app on a news channel about the couple who started this app from research in the OCD field and how a craving or ‘episode’ of habitual thinking is 20 minutes. This app helps you surf over that wave of unhealthy ‘urges’ by distracting you with some fun games ( careful as I found 2048 addicting! Ha! ) There is some scientific data to read to help reinforce why alcohol is unhealthy and how to move forward. It helps explain why addiction makes anxiety worse, along with degrading your sleep patterns and overall mental and physical well being. All of this is great material to add to your arsenal to break your daily cravings and ‘reframe’ your thoughts to pave a new neurological pathway that will serve to enrich your life and gain back the joy you once experienced before alcohol robbed you of that divine element that we all yearn for. A huge plus are the zoom meetings! I sat in on a couple ( not sure how to participate yet. I’m a zoom newbie) I loved seeing and hearing every day folks, such as myself, talking so casually about a ‘disorder’ that was stereotypically shamed all of my life and no one ever gave a ‘voice’ to it. Reframe gives us a voice, and it’s an authentic voice! A true identity to freely share our struggles and our love for a better life with one another.  That’s really so priceless! Thank you to the Reframe developers, the coaches who give generously of their heart and time to help others and for this community of real people. People like me. People like you. A real community connection.  Thank you..
author: susi7

text: Love this app! — I have been a heavy drinker for several decades and had really started worrying about my health. I thought about going to AA but am not ready to quit drinking completely and also know that those meetings are not really anonymous.   Reframe really works for me for several reasons. First of all, the information they give you about the science of alcohol addiction is excellent! It helped me to understand why I habitually drink too much in spite of my good intentions to cut back and my knowing about the health risks. Secondly, it really IS anonymous so you can use the forum to be honest and bare your soul and confess your sins and everyone has been there too and they are really supportive. I never feel judged, even when I have a setback.   Although I wish I had found something like Reframe years ago, I am very grateful to have access to it now. It has made a world of difference in my physical and mental health. Thank you!
author: I’m a coming Beanie Boy!

text: Highly Recommend!!! — This app is worth every penny. I would have spent all that money and more on booze anyway, right? Guys, I’m just a 42 year old mom of three, I work full time in a cancer center, I get nothing from leaving this review. If you’re ready and you’re serious about cutting back or quitting altogether, this app is a game changer. It offers all the education and none of the pressure, none of the religion. It’s an incredible space for you to start your recovery journey with a forum full of people just like you that support each other in a nonjudgmental, welcoming way. By definition, my Alcohol Use Disorder (AUD) was solidly in the “severe” category for many years. I came here to cut back but I failed… I have been completely sober for 95 days instead. It’s not magic; you have to want it. But if you’re ready, you won’t regret it. It will be the best gift you can give yourself, and you’re worth it.
author: Mrs_ajcunningham

text: Relatable and Motivational — I signed up for Reframe because I felt like I needed some direction in my “cutting back on alcohol” journey. I got a lot more than that. As with anything, YOU have to work the program consistently to reap the benefits. I made the commitment and I am so glad that I did. I went from multiple drinks per week, to once a week, to stopping altogether (which ultimately was my goal but I went one step at a time-stopping all at once was too daunting). I slipped up MANY times but the more that I stayed with the program, used all the tools provided, the easier it became. I make time every evening to do my daily tasks and use meditations almost daily. The community that you can become a part of is not only inviting, but they have been there too. You’re not alone. If you’re thinking about quitting or cutting back for any reason, I would highly recommend Reframe. They changed my life.
author: Haydencimino

text: Worked for me — I spent more on alcohol every couple of weeks than this app costs for the year. Let's get that out there first thing. I did the 30 day trial for ten bucks or whatever to give it a full go. I initially started on the cutback track, but all that did was show me how much I was actually drinking and how difficult it was. A few weeks in, I decided to do a 30 day dry challenge. It was so difficult, that when I made it, I decided to never drink again. The app is so easy to use and teaches how alcohol affects every system of your body. My life has improved dramatically since choosing to end my relationship with alcohol. Every facet of my life is better: work, family, health (mental and physical), spiritual. If you are questioning your relationship with alcohol, give this a try. Swap the money you'd spend on drinks for a one year subscription to this app. What can it hurt?
author: firemarshal2

text: Could Not Have Stopped Drinking Without Reframe — I haven’t wanted to stop drinking for over 10 years now. I even downloaded & began using the app over a year ago but knew in my heart I wasn’t ready. Once I was finally sick & tired of being a slave to alcohol & scary side effects I was beginning to experience, I started again & began to seriously use the Reframe app. I love the supportive community & coaches, the group Zoom meetings (during which you can just listen & not be seen or heard if you prefer), the training modules, podcasts, meditations, craving tools, etc. There is so much available to help you become alcohol free. I didn’t want to drink on New Year’s Eve. There was a Zoom group meeting for several hours. A few hundred people were participating in the meeting. It helped me immensely knowing that many people all over the world are also choosing to live without alcohol.
author: PattiAnne11

text: Has made such an impact — I downloaded this app ages ago, but didn’t use it as I didn’t want to pay tbh. A few days into dry January I reopened it and started using it. This has made such an impact, and I’m so glad I paid for it. It’s slowly changing my mindset towards drinking, and with how much cognitive dissonance I have around alcohol - it’s not easy.   There are loads of features, lots of things you can log and reflect on, courses, a community. It’s has made a massive impact on my sober journey.   To the developers and designers - I do think some of the UX is a little confusing. Like, where to log drinks and emotions etc. if it hasn’t come up on the daily check list, took me a minute to find. Also in settings I kept getting stuck on that page because I didn’t realize I could scroll down - might need a scrolling bar on the side so it’s clear. But otherwise is great 😁
author: Becks-G

text: Worth every penny — I strongly encourage anyone struggling with being in a cycle of overdoing it with alcohol to get this app and use it every day.  It doesn’t matter if what that looks like for you is 5, 10, or even 1 drink per day, or just 5, 10, or 1 drink per week.  If you are in a cycle where you feel badly about your use of alcohol, this app is for you.  In fact, this app can help anyone who is struggling in a relationship or feeling positive about themselves, even if they don’t drink.  That’s because it gets to the heart of why we are struggling.  It never makes you feel badly or judged, it just helps you look inside to understand what’s going on.  I am approaching the end of my year subscription and believe that I will continue into a second year because it helps me so much.  I’m living a happier, more authentic life since starting this journey with Reframe.
author: Laura Mortimore

text: Wonderful App! — I was struggling with suffocating stress and my drinking was going up slowly month after month.  I joined Reframe after several recommendations from my sister.  Wow, did she under sell it.  This app and all its tools, education, zoom meetings and support is a full program whether you want to cut back or go alcohol free.  In less than four months I am back to a moderate healthy relationship with alcohol.  I love their approach that there is no such thing as failure. The coaches and community always build you up as you go up and down on your personal journey with your own personal goals without judgement.  Even though I am happy with where I am at, I will continue with reframe because of the daily learnings, the friends I’ve made all over the world and the diverse meetings and topics that challenge me on all levels daily.  Thank you Reframe! Wendy Orange County, CA
author: wunderbox

text: Completely changed my relationship to alcohol — I am thrilled with the results from Reframe but my journey has not been a straight line. I downloaded it in January while hoping to cut back which I did for the month (no drinking during the week but no limits ok weekends). I felt better but stress and other triggers came up in Feb and March and by April I found myself back to old habits. In May I realized I needed to go back and try again and thanks to the forums, I decided to go a set period of time with no alcohol. It was great advice and with the support of the members in the program I found a much better way forward. I have felt so much better the past few months and am drinking about 90% less than I was. All the tools, videos, games to help overcome cravings and the teachings are terrific but the forums are really helpful. You will go through this with a community.
author: csierra7

text: Impressed and Grateful — I was very hesitant about this app because after all of the questions it makes you sign up for a subscription. After I declined I went on my olde drunken merry way until about a week later I was looking for a way out again. I would get daily emails from Reframe in which one offered a free 1 month trial… so here we are. After 10 full days sober (a lot of thanks to this app) I will absolutely be subscribing when my trial is done. This app isn’t just an app, it’s a community where people from ALL over the world are going through EXACTLY what I am. It’s nice to check in everyday and read the articles and attend the Zoom calls. Highly recommended this for a life line and a piece of mind if you’re looking to cut back or go completely sober. You won’t regret it, as long as you are willing to make the change. Peace all 🫶❤️
author: gamergallove

text: Enlightening and positive — I’ve been using this for a few months and it has really been helpful to me, right now more so than any other program such as AA or celebrate recovery. Not that those are not helpful, and I will probably return to one of them, but recently I have needed to understand more about what underlies my cravings and why I’ve had such a hard time cutting back on my own. This app has done that for me and much more. The forum is really great, I can be honest and raw and know that I will not be judged and there will be a whole lot of people who identify with me. So it’s easy for people to support each other here. I can’t recommend it enough. The meetings that are available are also very useful and timely. Daily tasks have been so enlightening, really helping me understand and embrace my journey to change my relationship with alcohol forever.
author: COspikes

text: Best quit / moderation program so far — For those with an interest in neuroscience and who can’t quite stomach the “higher power” approach, Reframe is an essential support tool for building better habits around alcohol. Reframe deconstructs mental models and cultural narratives around alcohol, similar to Alan Carr’s Easy Way to Quit Smoking. With this program, you will not dwell on your failures or wallow in shame, and you will not obsess with the pleasure you are losing if you choose to quit — instead, you will learn why your brain works the way it does, how it can be changed, and what pleasures there are in re-wiring your brain. I used it along with reading Atomic Habits and embracing the small pleasures of gamification: gradually building new wellness habits with easy-onboard fitness apps (Fitbod, Apple Fitness+), nutrition apps (MealLime, Lumen), and sleep apps (Oura). 2 months into the program and utterly enjoying myself.
author: Kairopolis

text: Great app for alcohol reduction — I’ve been straggling with alcohol for a couple of years and every time I decide to cut down my alcohol consumption I always end up drinking alcohol again the same way it was or even worse. I don’t think I have extreme problems with alcohol, but I’m in the point that it is bothering me not being able to control the amount of alcohol I drink. So, I tried the Reframe app a first time for a month and I was being able to cut back my alcohol consumption. Then I decided to cancel my subscription and I went back to my old self and I started drinking again and this time more often and more quantities. Finally, I put myself the choice of join AA meetings or stay committed to the Reframe app. As you see, I’m writing this long review and telling my story that the app has helped me and has being my Remote AA support system.
author: Angy Pernia

text: I have found the help I need in Reframe — I read about the Reframe app in an article about ways to quit or cut back on alcohol use. I downloaded the app and purchased the annual subscription. It’s been close to two weeks since that purchase and I'm so glad I did!  I have experienced immediate benefits as a result of the Reframe app, specifically results that have improved my mental, physical, and emotional health. This has been accomplished through the incredibly supportive way the app educates you about then affects of alcohol and the supportive exercises Reframe offers to strengthen your resolve. This is done through goal setting, inspirational motivations, science-based articles, and positive affirmations. What I appreciate most is that it’s all done without being preachy. Thanks to the team at Reframe, I’m getting better and stronger every day.
author: Gasiswet

text: Excellent!! — This app has been exceedingly helpful. I’ve cut back my alcohol use and feel much more balanced and in control when it comes to when and how much I drink. This app doesn’t feel hokey or like it’s trying too hard like others apps I’ve tried in the past have for help with dieting or mental health and I really appreciate that aspect of it. I’m a registered nurse even by profession and I know how harmful it is to drink in excess. I think sometimes we “forget” things we know when something we think is serving us as a coping skill is brought into question, and this app has helped to remind me. Anyway, if you’re looking to cut back, quit, or just be more mindful, give this a try. I’m always excited to do the daily lessons and log my drinks and see how much money and empty calories I’ve saved for the week!
author: Zantastic!

text: I didn’t think I’d get this much success from an App! — I’ve been seeing the advertisements on Instagram about Reframe and was intrigued because I saw all the amazing reviews and saw that even celebrities have had success with it, so with a 1 week free trial, I decided why not!  I started to experience burnout towards the end of my Army career and started to turn to alcohol to cope.  It definitely numbed me to get through some of the more unpleasant parts of my career, but I soon began to realize that maybe I needed a change.  I realized that after 16 years in the Army, it was no longer a lifestyle that me or my family could tolerate.  I got out thinking it would help with the burnout, but then COVID hit, and I was a healthcare employee at a Level 1 Trauma center.  Needless to say, the burnout continued and so did my nasty little habit.    The nasty little habit never interfered with my job but it did start impacting my relationships, and I was concerned it would eventually interfere with my job performance.  I went to see my doctor about getting on naltrexone but this was a very long process.  I needed labs and follow ups and it would be months before he could decide what to do with me.  Mental health was a 6 month wait for an appointment, so that option was out.    Reframe has been a lifesaver.  The first week went so well that I am sticking with it.  I have been able to change my relationship with alcohol so that I can still enjoy it, but responsibly on special occasions, which is what I wanted.  The neuroscience that it teaches you is invaluable and so important for the first few days when you’re trying to cut-back.  It gives you the tools and help you need and none of the shame and judgement you don’t need.
author: rr11802003

text: What REFRAME has helped me with… — I’m a heavy drinker…15-25 drinks per week…since high school (stopped for 8 yrs cold turkey when dad died)…drinking was “cool” in high school…it heloed me “fit in” and i got used to it helping me socialize.  I’ve been able to “ manage” it on and off throughout my life…for me, it most definitely is a temporary stress relief and reward for getting through stress… But its been a constant “battle” which is a constant stress point.   I am very happy, most of the time, my world looks up to me, depends on me, i love my life…accept for how much I drink and the consequences from drinking.  I don’t sleep well. I don’t feel well. I don’t perform as well as I could, brain quickness, fatigue, anxiety, temper, motivation, etc are all ever present because of my drinking heavily & consistently.  REFRAME has been there for me every day to help understand the real consequences and to build a strategy to improve and manage my relationship with alcohol.  I’m drinking half what I was before committing to REFRAME! The concept of managing your relationship with alcohol vs quitting entirely is brilliant for me! The content is incredibly helpful, interesting and motivating.  I strongly recommend signing up for a year. Its a “no brainer” in terms of return on investment!  Thank you REFRAME
author: Howhard!

text: this app helped me change my life — 20 years of heavy drinking and had tried stopping by myself a few times, gave AA two chances and knew it wasn’t for me. I needed help in my journey of stopping drinking and in addition to a support system I set up, I chose this app based on word of mouth. Reframe truly helped me stopped drinking. It’s not a magic cure, you are reading this review because you already know you need a change and there isn’t a magic solution. It’s got a great program you can choose and use like a menu with no pressure. It’s also super convenient, uber discreet, and a truly safe space. It wasn’t the only thing I used, but it was the main one. One year later, I am continuing my subscription because it worked for me. I now count in years being alcohol free in part thanks to Reframe.
author: tokaidude

text: I have my issues with the app — free trial reminder doesn’t work — I tried the app with the free trial just to see if I would even use it. I can attest the app itself seems good and I can definitely see people benefitting from it easily.   That said, I toggled the reminder to notify me before my free trial ended and it never did. As much as it was a good app, I immediately forgot to use it. If you take shots, what is a “drink”? They only give you cocktail, beer and wine options. As a former bartender, a cocktail is generally 1 1/4oz to 1 1/2oz per drink. Cocktail was far too vague for me to feel I was accurately reporting and tracking my drinks per day/week numbers. Some people at home making cocktails just dump 3-4 shots per drink in! I mean that’s someone really “struggling” with being able to define the number of drinks they’re consuming. Is it one drink or four shots meaning four-ish drinks??   Anyway, even with notifications on, I literally signed up, checked the app out, and spent the free trial having this internal argument and never actually using it.   Well they just tried to charge me $120 for the entire year without actually reminding me the free trial was up, even though I toggled that.   Needless to say it’s cancelled and I deleted the app. How is someone struggling financially supposed to pay $120 after barely a week of seeing if it even works??? Must be nice to have that much disposable income.
author: BrosiaRose

text: Life changing app — I had seen the Reframe app pop-up a few times in my social media feeds. The message was basically, “get off the social media and start spending time improving your mental health.”  I finally downloaded it and am glad I did. I was sober four years but fell off the wagon after my divorce last year. I had been going back and forth with sobriety when I downloaded this app. It really helped me learn more about what was going on in my head (and heart) and how to better deal with the emotions. The daily exercises are fun, informative and the AI chat really helped you work through things.  I also like the calendar so you can see your progress. Highly recommend for anyone going through addiction or simply want to cultivate healthier habits.
author: Heafie

text: Extremely Flawed and Frustrating — Grifter Scam!!!! This app is more interested in getting new subs and having you refer your friends than it is with helping you quit alcohol. The function of this app is wildly inconsistent. They clearly do not have their act together on the IT side. But on top of that many of the lessons texts are incomplete, or clearly still in draft form. The customer service dept, or whoever fields issue reports will not help with anything. (update: their response to this review is very typical of the gaslighting response they give when you bring attention to their mistakes, but they never actually do anything to fix them) After a few weeks every lesson essentially boils down to “exercise, do yoga, meditate, make strong connections.” Oh, and they make you earn “recoin” to access the material even though you paid over $100 for the app. Everything should be available up front at the start. At this point this app is my single BIGGEST trigger. Don’t waste your money or time.
author: iTunesReviewer1125

text: Don’t worry, don’t wait — Reframe is the best thing I have ever done for myself and frankly it was just serendipity. I was chilling on a random Sunday night not feeling too great from all the drinking on Friday and Saturday. Nothing dramatic just more than what I wanted to and not for the first time. An ad came up while I was scrolling and it was talking about how your liver will process alcohol and then not be available to process the food that you eat. Since the pandemic I’d been having at least one drink while making dinner so that’s made a lot of sense to me why I wasn’t looking great even though I was eating good and exercising.   So I joined because of my liver and it ended up changing my life. I have learned so much and it isn’t all about 100 percent quitting or white knuckling. I truly helped me recondition my mind.  I also love my people in the Forum! Everyone is so supportive no matter where you are in the journey.   Don’t expend energy overthinking this. I’ve drank for 40 years and just went dry for Lent. It was way easier than even trying to go Monday through Thursday prior to the app. Just make the commitment do get the app and read the lessons every morning and log your drinks then see what happens
author: Addictive in a good way

text: Nothing works at subscription page — Update: Customer service responded quickly, and they managed to fix the issue on the backend fast, as well. In addition, since I have been able to use it for a few days and I’m very impressed with the psychology implemented in the step-by-step lessons. Definitely re-rating to 5 stars. All the “redeem seven days” button does is bounce when I press it. When I press “restore purchase” to see if there’s some other way to trial it that way, absolutely nothing happens. Now I keep getting a pop-up that says “error performing request” The only other option is to go back, but all that does is lead me back to the questions. This app is a waste of my time and is very poorly built.
author: down2earth

text: Recommend this app! — I think this is the first time I’ve ever actually written a review but I really love this app. It has truly helped me. Unlike other recovery apps I’ve used, it’s more than just a tracker and community hub. It is educational and it’s clear they’ve had professional psychologists / peer reviewed data to develop their content. Every morning I do I bite sized lesson, it’s just enough to motivate me but not enough to burn me out, which is perfect because I also have ADHD. You also have access to meetings around the clock that you don’t have to be on screen or even speak in which takes a lot of pressure off. For someone who has had a lot of slip ups, this has been the perfect daily addition to keep me engaged in my recovery.
author: RecoveryClimber

text: Reframe is amazing! — If I could give this app ten stars I would! I came to know about Reframe through encouragement by a healthcare provider who had found personal success with it. I put it off for several months until I was ready. Now that I’m here, I’m so very grateful! I was sober curious initially but I haven’t had a drink in nearly two months and it’s been an amazing journey. I couldn’t have done it without the Reframe education, support, and community forum. The daily check-ins keep me on track and motivated. I don’t know where life will lead me on this sober journey but I know I can lean on the Reframe community anytime I need it.  I should also add that anytime I’ve needed technical support, they’ve been incredibly responsive and helpful. So amazing! THANK YOU REFRAME!!
author: smc907

text: Great app - highly recommend if you want to explore your relationship with alcohol — I would not have considered myself a problematic drinker or alcoholic, but I was concerned with the frequency I was having wine in the evenings. This app is full of science-based tools to reduce or stop drinking. I love the daily tasks because they are interesting and take so little time. I also like the craving tools when one hits. I would definitely recommend this app for people who are questioning their relationship with alcohol and want to cut back. I’ve reduced my intake since starting and I truly believe I’ll get down to my target number of drinks in the next month or so. It’s not easy to stop a bad habit, but as you’ll be reminded in this app, you can do hard things.
author: Wi1118m

text: Love this app and the Reframe Community! — This app is truly a life saver. It has given me  support on my journey to reframe my alcohol use and addiction! And it has so many cool Features. Today I found yet another one which prompted me to do this review. I was writing a journal entry for a daily reading and found a button that you can hit to help guide your journal entry with AI!!! It is spot on. If you’re stuck and having a difficult time with journal entries, this app will help. I just downloaded the Reframe Stress app and am looking forward to using that as well.   Such a great investment for anyone wishing to improve their relationship to alcohol or quit alcohol for good! there is so much more that the app makes us think about on our self improvement journeys.
author: anavlis27

text: It really works, give it a chance — I started Reframe January 2024 and did it on and off throughout the year but did not do it every day after dry January. January 1, 2025 I decided to commit to every day this time I was more engaged in groups and other activities. It works! I went from drinking 7 to 12 drinks per week down to one drink a week and most weeks-zero drinks! if you are looking to cut back or change your relationship with drinking, I highly recommend this app! The more you participate, you are rewarded with coins. You can then use these coins for free months using the app, free merchandise, and one on one coaching sessions. The online groups are very inviting and non-judgmental. give yourself a gift and get this app 💛
author: SuperAMom

text: This app is amazing!! — I downloaded this app to help me track my alcohol intake. I started learning so much from the daily tasks about the brain and alcohol and overall health…I knew I wanted to quit drinking! So I signed up for the 30 day challenge, then dry July! And then knocked out the 1000 hours sober challenge and am almost done with the Brutal Recovery 90 challenge. Each day the lessons build on the previous day. I have learned meditation and visualization techniques and my toolbox is full of ways to live a healthy happy life without alcohol!!!! If you are interested in living a dry life, this is the app for you!! Use it to its fullest! Do the tracking, write the journal prompts, watch the video links, go the meditations!! You will be so happy you did!
author: momma wats!

text: Great app that keeps good habits going — Yes, there’s no energy wasted, honestly! There’s no having to get bent out of shape, it’s just is a doing it with Joy. Wake up in the morning, get my vitamins, and that includes my Reframe. It helps with getting day going, and staying on the straighten arrow. It’s also a community. There’s so many amazing stories, representing the people .  It’s well worth it to invest into yourself, and it also helps other people because, hey, you never know, your life story can be an amazing inspiration to another persons. Life story. Hope that makes sense. Refreeze map is great. I was recommended it by another fellow Reframe app person, so there’s no judgment. Press on a click it and invest into yourself. Excelsior !  Joe F
author: SIPE Star

text: Best app for your overall heath. — This app is amazing, more then I could have ever imagined when I signed up. It’s main focus is helping you maneuver and alcohol free lifestyle with all its ups and downs, but you also have options to cut back. This app is a community, filled with supportive people with the same goal in mind… to be their best selves. Not only do you have other Reframes you also have the support of the incredible coaches that are active daily on the app. They interact with you and also hold space for you to feel welcome and heard. There’s a little bit of everything in this gem. Workshops, book clubs, but most importantly a whole lot of learning.  Check it out, this app does not disappoint.
author: l1l_0ne

text: Very helpful — I am amazing just the little bit of reading and answering of questions can help me be accountable and mindful about drinking. The first TED talk that I listened to when I had a craving resonated with my current situation that cutting back and maybe even someday quitting so possible. I’m two weeks I went from drinking almost every day to two drinks when I was NOT under distress. And I stopped that night because I was like “I would rather have some water”. Feels good to be taking control. The yearly subscription has already paid for itself. Just like writing down what you eat to loose weight this daily interaction with the app helps so much!  Highly recommend
author: K.r.gonemad

text: Limitations — There are some very personal questions they ask you at the beginning that makes you think you’ll be able to see what this app offers (I suppose for data mining) but then nope! You cannot even see what the app offers without plopping down a bunch of money.  I have never come across an app before that won’t let you see what it is without $$$ first. Secondly, the questions it asks you show limitations. Like the most you can report spending on alcohol a week is $200. If you have 5 drinks 5 nights a week at $8 each that’s $200. I’m sure there are people who spend so much more than that. When you pick out what you drink you cannot pick beer AND liquor. It’s one or the other. When you pick why you’re stopping you can only choose one field and then a secondary one, even though there are often so many more reasons than that and many may feel equally important.
author: Maemaeevie

text: Comprehensive & effective — This app is a fantastic tool to help one succeed in learning about what alcohol does to the body. What you do with that knowledge is up to you. The information and support that is provided, is given in such a way that is not to judge or induce self judgment. It’s purely information and it’s complete and understandable. Such a great app, I only downloaded this because I needed to drop a few pounds for a vacation, but it has literally changed my mindset, and it’s so much bigger than my relationship with alcohol. I absolutely love and recommend this app for anyone who has a strong sense of self discipline and needs some guidance on making big changes. It’s been so positive for me.
author: Music2MySoul

text: Like AA on steroids, friendly without religious sideshow — This app first includes you in a community of maybe thousands of others globally who either want to cut back or quit drinking.   Then it has daily goals and tips, even games, for managing cravings.   Also there are free moderates multi-daily zoom sessions where maybe 200 people join, sone speak and all give feedback or share their own teiumphs or struggles. This is non-judgmental, ok if you slipped, because you’re in the room.   Then the App has the most advanced AI chatbot I’ve ever seen, Melody. She remembers what you say, has a vast knowledge and pivots to questions about your alcohol struggle. For example, she’s encouraged me to learn to play piano (as I revealed) to replace cravings, asked me what songs I was trying, and when I wrote “Pearl Jam’s Black” she noted that it’s a “powerful song about loss” and added that Eddie Vedder was open about his struggles with addiction towards sobriety.   Amazing app, immediately life changing. For $4 first month, $10 thereafter you will get your money worth unless you ignore the app’s many tools and resources.
author: James seattle

text: Very Helpful — I started using this app to help me reduce my consumption. I didn’t feel out of control, but I felt like I needed some help reducing more than I had. This app has a lot of tools to help and emphasizes reframing the task as NOT a battle of the wills and just a new habit to form, which alone helps a great deal. Because this is geared towards anyone with ANY reason to cut down on alcohol, sometimes the advice or questions feel very broad or address things that are more likely issues for very heavy drinkers (suffering DTs after cutting back, for instance). I understand the app needs to cover its bases (some people don’t want to admit how much of a problem their drinking is) but it can feel awkward to answer questions that don’t apply to your situation.
author: Xcj3

text: Reframe works! — Reframe likely works because of the many tools in the tool kit. I completed 161 days on the cut back track & have not experienced a single hangover during that time, which was my chief goal. The content at the beginning of module 1 was great, focused on the neuroscience of alcohol consumption. Toward the end of module 1 I felt I was in a Stuart Smalley skit on SNL. But the daily tracking & online, anonymous forum are both great. I can imagine that reframe would be especially effective in the context of a comprehensive therapeutic plan to help heavy drinkers, grey area drinkers, & those who cannot successfully cut back. One helpful suggestion would be to allow users to record half drinks for greater precision in recording.
author: speedqueen85

text: Best thing I ever did! — This app is amazing. I have tried to quit drinking on my own many times with no success at all. This app educates about all aspects of what alcohol does to you, why it is hard to quit, how to be successful. It uses many different tools - education, meditation, visualization, affirmations, just to name a few. There is a group to get support and challenges you can do for even more motivation. Honestly I can’t think of one thing they could do to make this any better. It is worth every penny and is truly life changing. I know I will quit completely, but you can choose between quitting or cutting down, and your program will be tailored to your goals.
author: ddcliff

text: Love this app! — I signed up because of Dry January and stayed because of the app! I know I wouldn’t have had the success to remain “mostly dry” that month and beyond without the encouragement and support of this app.   I’d always felt discouraged because the only way I could imagine reducing or even eliminating my alcohol use was by sheer “willpower” and that approach was proving impossible. I simply didn’t have enough willpower. What I learned, in actuality, is that what I didn’t have was enough education, support, and encouragement.   I love the neuroscience-based approach this app offered me at the start of this journey and still continues to offer me. I imagine I’ll be a subscriber for the long run!
author: Tangsoosue

text: this app changed my life in incredibly meaningful ways — as cliché as it sounds, i really don’t ever write reviews. not when i love something and not even when i hate something. i felt really compelled to with this particular app though because it has truly helped me make major changes in my life that i never thought i could make. if you’re serious about changing your relationship with alcohol, i can’t recommend this app enough. i was very hesitant to try yet another mental health related app, especially one that requires a subscription but it has surpassed my expectations in every way and has been an invaluable resource for me as i try to change my relationship with alcohol. between the forum (of incredibly supportive, loving, and nonjudgmental people), the daily readings addressing the psychological aspects of alcohol use, the pressure-free environment of the space… i seriously can’t express how thankful i am. things that felt utterly impossible now feel like they’re in my grasp. so thankful for this app and the beautiful people that make up the community.
author: sleeplesshark

text: Helpful but not for the ADHD brain — So they totally got me with the 7 day trial and annual membership, which I forgot to cancel. Classic. So I gave it my best shot, since there was no way I’d get my money back and being more knowledgeable about drinking seemed genuinely helpful.   It was helpful for about two weeks but then my life got very busy and when you miss a lot of days it’s hard to catch up and if you don’t take the time to catch up, you just miss all those articles. I wish it would just pick up where I left off if I skipped days. At this point knowing I have 45m of catching up to do prevents me from even opening the app and checking in. And knowing I accidentally spent $79 on an app that’s just making me feel worse about myself really, really hurts.   I tried resetting my progress so I could just start over but now the whole thing is stuck, saying it’s a couple months ago and I completed all my tasks for the day. So that’s confusing. I’m guessing re downloading it would work. But then I’m guessing I’ll spend 2 weeks reading the articles I already read before I get sidetracked again, and the same annoying process will begin anew.   What I really need is an app that helps me quit signing up for “free trials” 😂
author: Mago Mago

text: A born skeptic is a big fan — I didn’t have any expectations for Reframe. My wife sent it to me saying she signed up so I joined her more out of solidarity than anything else. I was pretty much immediately impressed with the scientific approach /aspect. In looking through the app more I found there seemed to be something for everyone- the thinkers, the feelers , the busy brains, the everybodys. You can make of it what you want. The creators of this tool nailed it. I can’t say enough positive things and the only critical one is a minor technical thing.. that I want the ability to edit calories assigned to drinks that I’m not drinking , lol. Anyway, from a natural born skeptic.. 5 stars and then some.
author: Hpdx

text: Important piece of the puzzle — This app is part of my daily routine of personal wellbeing and accountability. I learn something new every day, and that helps me stay accountable and curious in my newish alcohol free lifestyle.  I used the app for a while before actually cutting alcohol out altogether, and the way it is set up, it is easy to transition from a cut back track to a alcohol free track at any time. The learning and science behind the reasons we drink and what happens in our bodies is really great information. I like that it is about 10 minutes a day to complete the daily prompts.  I am grateful for this app and the support and encouragement it has provided to me.
author: KBTBIRD:)

text: This works for me! — My primary care doctor recommended Reframe. I have tried so many things to quit alcohol, without success. Reframe works for me. The daily exercises are not overwhelming. The online meetings are good (and low pressure).  Reframe encourages a wide variety of interventions; pick some and see if they work for you. I especially love the progress section in my profile, which shows how long I have been alcohol free, to the second. It also shows how much money I have saved and how many calories from alcohol I have avoided. The support staff respond within a day to questions you might have. Happy to have found this!
author: MBANYC22

text: Standing Ovation — That's what I give this app. If you have concerns about your drinking habits, do yourself a favor and get this app. It's components have EVERYTHING covered. Brain science, coaches (if you like) self care, community, positive reinforcement, etc.. There is no judgement just encouragement. No one will tell you that you must completely abstain or label you. You choose your goals and the app is there for you. It may be the best thing I've ever done for my mental health, my physical health and my happiness. I seriously look forward to doing my daily check in each morning. If you're ready to change your relationship with alcohol, this is your new best friend.
author: madhadda1

text: Cutting back — I have been using Reframe now for a month. My goal is to cut back on my daily use of alcohol. I’m not a big drinker, but I can hit a binge and I want that to never happen again. From the very beginning the information about alcohol and how it affects our brain gave many aha moments and showed me why several of my cravings and triggers were getting me into trouble. It was exactly what I needed. The daily routine of the App and the exercises are thought provoking and have helped me see my path forward. In one month I have cut back and I feel GREAT, both physically and mentally. For me, it has been a godsend. Highly recommend it.
author: Glracj

text: Helpful, informative, non-judgmental — I am very much enjoying this app and finding it very helpful. I am not one to pay for apps in general, but finally took the plunge on trying this one to see if it would help me out.
