Reframe is great at giving the TLDR version of scientific research on alcohol and the effects on the body systems and the psychology behind it- making it very digestible for any and all users. The platform is structured to be supportive and without shame on alcohol use or slip ups. I like the ability to add and remove certain exercises as well, tailoring your experience- also use it as a cut back tool or a quit tool.
author: SaraJBirdy

text: Life changing, truly — This app and community has TRULY been life changing for me. I can’t believe I took a chance and downloaded the app, did the free trial, and ZERO regrets and have happily paid for the next 12 months because of how blown away I am by Reframe. The app content, the community, zoom meetings, coaches, fellow reframers, everything- I have become the best version of myself because of all the above supporting and facilitating me every step of the way! Took a chance and boy did it work out for me! You get this one life, if you’re on the fence, there’s really no reason not to *try* and just see what it’s about!
author: Cbear9

text: Definitely glad I tried this. — It took a long time for me to want to change my relationship with alcohol because I thought it was an “all or nothing” situation.  But I was exhausted from the rollercoaster of hung-over me saying new day, no drinking, and afternoon me saying- let’s drink!   This app was such a positive surprise, helping create new habits and -this sounds bad- but I really thought I had heard it all about drinking and shocker, I had not.  Embarrassing.   The educational science and psychology that they share, in easy bites, has been a huge game changer.   It makes me think and it makes me relax.  And without all the judgement or shame.
author: nbw908

text: Brilliant App! Informative & Motivating, Bravo!! — Initially my intentions going in were to cut back/take a break. I made the commitment to check in with the Reframe app every day for the month of December and complete all tasks and reading (compactly informative and do-able!!).  It is the 28th, and I’m excited to dabble with living Alcohol-Free for 2024. I’m 28 days in my journey and honestly don’t miss it. You learn quickly healthy coping techniques, how to gain positive support, identify triggers and steps to manage them. My personal favorite is all the new knowledge I am equipped with and my daily health update! I honestly can say I look forward to using Reframe daily.
author: Hil S.

text: Excellent Support For Cutting Back — This app not only helps you track alcohol consumption, but gives you daily support on a number of other factors that influence drinking or not drinking.  It helps encourage and motivate you to reach your goals, as well as be gentle in overcoming the shame of drinking and even the shame in not drinking! I love that it gives the science and the “why” we drink, but that it also gives tools to work for each individual.  It has changed my alcohol use as well as the way I see alcohol in life in general, in so many great ways, and I am living a better life because of it! Thank you Reframe!
author: megaleen

text: This app is awesome!! — The neuroscience in this app is awesome. The forum for discussion is awesome. The ability to work on yourself without feeling shame & guilt is awesome. Really enjoying every aspect of the app. The ability to work on an abstinence or cut back track is awesome. Can’t speak highly enough about it. Already have recommended to one person and will recommend to anyone else I feel that it could help. Has been a super helpful tool!! One small thing that I have noticed is misplaced words that make sentences read funny but I figure it’s something to just help my perfectionist self grow!
author: Str8Nnarrow

text: SO supportive! — I use this app to reign myself in after vacations and time off work.  The health updates are my fave.  They let me know that each day without alcohol is productive on a health level.  I look forward to logging my 0 drinks days and when I log a drink, the app doesn’t shame me in ANY way.  As a matter of fact, if a weekend has some drinks in it, the app might recommend that I make my goal more reasonable.  Thank you Reframe for offering a user friendly accountability tool, as well as accurate health related information to go along with my progress.
author: K-Robbi

text: Highly recommend — As a person who has been abusing alcohol the past ten years and went to a high end rehab in Southern Cal on the beach, this app has all the education, support and structure my as they $30,000 a month rehab offered.   The tools provided and the set up is perfect. I am also a retired business manager so I can recognize good structure when I see it. I paid less than $100 for my membership plan. Well worth it.  I highly recommend Reframe.  Reach out, start the journey to find the old you or create a new better version of yourself!!  It works! #Campinggirl
author: lamborlandi

text: Great tool for sobriety — I’ve been in recovery for over 3 years but I’m always on the lookout for new tools to add to my sobriety toolbox. So far, digital sponsor has been an awesome addition. Compared to other addiction recovery apps I’ve used, Digital Sponsor is way more comprehensive and has a ton of sobriety tools I didn’t even know I needed! I really love the set up and how it is task-driven on a daily basis. Makes the whole “one day at a time” thing ring even more true. Highly suggest for anybody who wants to up their recovery game or is just looking for a great new tool to add to compliment their sober lifestyle
author: alliekcampbell

text: The Help YOU need — For me, Reframe stands out as a comprehensive support system for anyone looking to build a healthier relationship with alcohol. What makes this app particularly impressive is how it combines science-based approaches with cutting-edge technology.  The daily check-ins and mood tracking help you understand your triggers and patterns, while the educational content explains the science behind alcohol's effects on your body and mind. What sets Reframe apart is its innovative use of AI technology – the app provides personalized, insightful responses to your journal entries and reflections, making it feel like you have a supportive, understanding coach who truly "gets" your unique situation.  The app's text-to-speech feature deserves special mention. Instead of the robotic voices common in many apps, Reframe uses remarkably natural-sounding voice technology that makes the content feel more engaging and personal. Whether you're listening to daily lessons or motivational content, the realistic voice narration makes the experience feel more like a conversation with a caring friend than a digital tool.  The mix of cognitive behavioral therapy techniques and mindfulness exercises provide real alternatives to drinking, while the progress tracking features help visualize your achievements. The emergency toolkit is particularly thoughtful for handling challenging moments.  The community aspect provides a judgment-free space to connect with others on similar journeys, which helps reduce the isolation many feel when changing their drinking habits. The AI-enhanced interaction adds another layer of support, offering personalized insights and encouragement based on your specific entries and progress.  While the subscription cost might seem significant to some, the sophisticated technology, comprehensive support, and daily guidance make it a worthwhile investment in your health and wellbeing. It's like having both a knowledgeable coach and an empathetic friend in your pocket
author: Pristastic!

text: Awesome tool — Downloaded this to use during Dry January and zero regrets. I love all the different ways it helps to track and journal and most importantly, actually give the raw truth about alcohol, without sugar coating it like the rim of a daiquiri. This is knowledge everyone should have and I wish this would be a requirement before anyone is allowed to drink. Without knowing the true effects alcohol has on our bodies we are essentially getting behind the wheel without passing a drivers exam. Thank you, Kayla, for creating something so helpful at a time when it is needed most!
author: DreTPA

text: Helpful in conjunction with other treatment — I downloaded this app when I began my journey to sobriety. It has helped me gain awareness. The scientific information is incredibly useful and makes me feel comforted in the fact that my alcoholism is a health condition and not a character defect. I love the meditations. All of that said, I am in AA, and that is contributing largely to my sobriety. However Reframe helps keep me on track, and helps me feel more rounded and not completely dependent on the AA program. I recommend using it with a twelve step program or other kind of therapy or maybe outpatient treatment.
author: Vneeberry1982

text: Making changes! — I love this app! I downloaded it to help support my decision to reduce my consumption so I could lose weight and improve my health. The approach is great and doing it daily makes such a difference. I am about a month in and notice a difference on the days I don’t carve out time to check in. Even though my goal was to reduce my consumption I’m almost 1 mo alcohol free! It is very doable and short time commitment but very effective. I only wish they had an app that included this same approach to weight-loss/food relationships because the mindfulness/CBT really works!
author: Moodyvibes

text: A New Approach to Alcohol — After decades of believing that only some people are susceptible to losing control of how alcohol shows up in there lives, Reframe has totally changed my thinking.   Without shame, blame, or self-deprecating confessions of powerlessness, Reframe shifts the paradigm by showing that anyone who drinks can become emotionally and physically dependent on ethanol (the same chemical additive that fuels your car.) The folks at Reframe shine light on the neurophysiological effects of alcohol - effects to which ALL humans are susceptible, not just broken ones. They also expose powerful sociocultural influences that elevate drinking in every life context, as well as alcohol’s ubiquitous and highly profitable marketing machine.   The Reframe App provides education, interactive activities, great podcasts, community support, and much more.    Whether you’re considering cutting back or quitting drinking altogether, or you’re just “sober curious,” I highly recommend the Reframe App.
author: Another Reading RN

text: The BEST! — I honestly can not say enough good things about this app. I’ve tried to quit drinking many times beforehand and it wasn’t until I downloaded this app that I was finally able to stop. You learn the science behind the how and why of alcohol and it’s effects on the body. You learn ways to cope with cravings. You have a community to connect with that understands what you are going through. Plus health updates of how your body is healing the longer you stay alcohol free. This app has changed my life and I will be forever grateful for its existence.
author: Meesh.life

text: Incredibly Hard to Cancel — The reviews are great and the product sounds great, I never got the chance to try it because when I signed up, the timing wasn’t right with my schedule and so I wanted to pause and cancel, but that became incredibly difficult. if your product is so great put a cancel button otherwise you lead one to believe it’s all fluff.  Try to cancel after signing up for the three day free trial. You cant’t on App and the product will not show in your app subscriptions during this trial period so you can not cancel until AFTER you have been charged.  The app should be removed from the App Store until it has an easy to remove button. It kept trying to charge my bank account, took me weeks to finally get it to cancel.
author: JasonTexas21

text: Not AA…BETTER for people like me — Didn’t think an app would have enough to help me quit alcohol…until Reframe. I have no words to describe how invaluable the tools provided have helped me quit alcohol completely. Supportive and more informative than I EVER imagined. The science behind what alcohol does to the human body backs EVERYTHING on the app. And the community is unsurpassed. I have “friends” all over the world now. If you are questioning your relationship with drinking, try it out. You have nothing to lose…but you might get your life back better than ever!
author: AntlersMay

text: Reframe Review! — For the price of what I used to spend on ONE NIGHT of drinks out, I have a comprehensive tool to improve my health, relationships and work career. That’s a bargain!      Reframe is a solid, no nonsense approach to a baffling, multifaceted problem. It allows me to maintain focus on healing, without being preachy or judgmental.       Nothing will work for everyone. It’s just not that simple. However, once a person makes the decision to pursue a positive change in their life by facing their alcohol problem, this app is a very powerful ally to help achieve that goal!      5 stars, all day long!
author: Motorrad12

text: Nothing but upsides — I am so glad I signed up with Reframe a few months ago. I was growing increasingly less comfortable with my alcohol use but wasn’t really sure how to approach it. Reframe really helped me feel empowered and confident with my relationship to drinking. I am now very clear about who is in the driver’s seat! In three months I have cut down my total drinks by at least half, and have way more nights that I go without drinking at all. As an added bonus I am sleeping more soundly and my anxiety is definitely decreased as well.  Thanks Reframe Team!
author: NomadicQ

text: Game changer for me — I love & appreciate this app. It has been helpful for me to check in. There’s many different aspects to this app to fine tune it to your needs & learn what works for you during this life journey. The forum is welcoming & no judgment. You can & ought to be honest to be true to yourself using the forum & all the different tools on here. If you’re here then I would highly suggest giving it a try. You have nothing to lose & all to gain. It’s funny, I’ve been on here since March & I don’t know how I found this app but I am ever grateful. Peace.
author: MidwesternGurl

text: It’s definitely helping me! — I decided to do Dry January and felt that I needed some extra help if I was going to be successful. My friend told me about Reframe. It has been super-helpful! I’ve learned a lot about alcohol that I never knew-information that has helped me stay dry. Also, I’ve been impressed with the mood checks. Occasionally, Reframe checks you for depression and anxiety. I see a doctor for those things and I recognize the questions Reframe uses from my experience with him. This is a real high quality app. And it works!
author: Jaythedrummer123

text: If you’re even slightly questioning your drinking… — …then download this app. This is my first app review but I can’t think of a more useful and educational tool I’ve ever had around alcohol. This is the education we all should receive in school. I’m 100 days sober and this app and the community forum feature have been a huge part of that. I started out on the cutback track but after learning more about alcohol through this app I decided to completely cut it out and it’s literally the best decision I’ve ever made for myself.
author: KammaClaire

text: Sneaky!!! — I’m going to reluctantly flatter the developers for succeeding at giving the “appearance” of a wholesome, safe environment. But 9 days after purchasing I noticed that the forum is moderated by patronizing, cliche-driven fake “support”. The real drive of the app is to push 1-1 coaching and additional classes. Comments are filtered. Nothing debatable exists in the forums. Very few people are actually posting or discussing real life issues. The app is an insult to my intelligence. It completely lacks transparency. There is no way to contact the developer with questions. There’s no email provided. The educational aspect is well-done but requires you read only a little a day. You can not jump ahead and keep going in the learning process. Looks pretty but ends up being a disappointment.
author: LongIsland&Cragsmoor

text: A godsend — I’m only on day three of using this app, but so far it’s the only thing that’s actually made me stop drinking. I’ve been unbearably stressed over the last couple of months after losing my job and being unable to find another one, and I’ve been drinking heavily every night. My  drinking problems, like most people’s, began very gradually over time—so gradually that I didn’t realize it was turning into an actual problem until a few months ago. I’d say I’ve been a relatively heavy drinker for a couple years now, mostly from the stress of working in the hospitality industry during covid, and it’s just gotten so much worse the last couple of months.   I’ve tried therapy sessions, AA just isn’t my thing right now since most meetings are virtual and I just cannot get into it, but this app has helped me not drink a single drop of alcohol for two whole days. It might seem small to some, but for me it’s a huge deal. I’ve had cravings here and there, but I’ve been using the craving mode in the Reframe toolbox when they surface, and so far I’ve been successful in not even considering going to the liquor store. I’ve not yet arrived at a point in my addiction where I’m experiencing any of the physical effects of withdrawal—it’s pretty much all psychological at this point—so if that’s your case then this app may not be enough for you, I’m not sure. All I know is, I’ve woken up feeling great instead of hungover and groggy two mornings in a row, and it’s truly all thanks to this app.   I was skeptical about the price per month at first, but the $25 I’ve spent thus far has already saved me that much or more in the cost of alcohol I probably would’ve bought were it not for downloading Reframe. For now I’m trying to just cut back significantly on my drinking to get it down to what’s considered safe by national health guidelines. I’m highly confident I can make it to the end of the week without giving in, which is the goal I’ve set on the app. There are tons of features that have kept me engaged and motivated, and I haven’t even explored them all yet. It’s almost like therapy without the shame and fear of judgement that inevitably comes with disclosing one’s problems to a person face to face, and it’s always a few clicks away in my pocket whenever I need it. So very grateful I found Reframe! I highly recommend it, whether you’re a gray area drinker or a heavy drinker like myself. Time to stop wasting away my body and making more time for what’s important.
author: nicknamebrokentryagain

text: Reframe is worth every penny! — If you want to cut back on or completely eliminate alcohol, this app is a great start. It’s really easy to use and extremely informative. I didn’t want to eliminate completely - just cut back - but this app keeps me on track. There are a lot of tips to help with cravings, a goal tracker, and outside assistance with other users in the forum. I have had the app for less than two weeks, and it will pay for itself within another week. I am beginning to see and feel positive results!
author: dgfgjvdg

text: Love this app and continue to use it daily — I've been using reframe for multiple years.  I initially signed on looking for recuction, and finally decided to leave alcohol behind a long time ago.  I still learn something every single day I use the app, and of course it's gone well beyond anything to do with alcohol which is the underpinning of it's success: it's about personal growth that happens to result in less dependence on substances.  It's worth doing, and then continuing to do after any desired outcome with alcohol is achieved.
author: dgerrity

text: Disappointing — I had trouble initially logging in when I first downloaded the app and had to remake my profile several times. Once I downloaded it, I tried to log my drinks and it won’t save my information. When I tried to set the weekly baseline it also would not save. I tried restarting my phone and nothing changed. This has been over several weeks I tried to get it to work and I’m a patient person, but it’s not saving my information and it’s very disappointing that I paid for an app to help me reach my goals and it is just a source of frustration. I had my fiancé who works in tech check it and said I have everything set correctly and it should work. Very disappointed, do not recommend.
author: Anna Kay Art

text: Factual and non-shaming! — I’ve always known that my relationship with alcohol was a risky one. Sometimes I could control my consumption, other times would lead to blacking out and making mistakes. I’ve tried to reduce my use many times, but finally was confronted with it not being the route for me.   Since using reframe I’ve been alcohol free (coming from 4 drinks a day)! This app has encouraged me and empowered me in ways I never would have believed! It’s all fact base, never using shame or higher power language, and gives space for you to tackle this journey in whatever way you see fit (cutting back, being alcohol free, etc.).   The forum feature offers community when you feel stuck and the reflection features give space to better understanding alcohols role in your life.   100% the best thing I did when my therapist advised me to go to AA. Instead I’ve done reframe!
author: MSchleif

text: Reframe — Excellent program to help me cut back my drinking. The neuroscience behind alcohol and the brain is explained clearly. I have learned valuable, useful information that has been instrumental in my journey. The feedback and support I have found through the app is beyond anything I expected. Response to technical questions are answered quickly and input from the client community is taken seriously which is very helpful. Give this app a try as I did, you will not regret it. Literally, it has changed my life.
author: ronizoom

text: My favorite app, ever! — For those of us who respond to a more open, individualized approach to cutting back on or quitting alcohol, this app is fantastic.  It holds you accountable to yourself and is informative, encouraging and very user friendly.   I was skeptical at first, but I really enjoy this app and it’s been indispensable on my journey back to better health.  I’ve also had a few questions along the way, and they’re extremely responsive and personable.  Just a very positive experience that puts me in a great “frame” of mind.
author: kcm0005

text: Reframe is a Great App — With the Reframe App I have cutback my drinking with the hope of going alcohol free for the first time in 15+ years of daily drinking. I have tried to quit many times on my own but the science behind reframe really made the connection for me. The cravings are less and feel like I am on a positive trajectory for the first time in many years. I’ve only used the app for a week and chose to actually purchase it based on the progress I made in that one week. I will keep using it daily. Thanks Reframe!!
author: Warrant Princess

text: CHANGED. MY. LIFE. — This app is great for anyone re-thinking their relationship with alcohol. It gives you real facts about the effects of alcohol on your body and brain, as well as strategies you can use immediately in your daily life. There’s access to a community of people including tons of daily meeting options led by credentialed moderators. This is NOT a 12-step program, and can easily be integrated into any lifestyle or identification along the alcohol use spectrum. It has literally changed my life since day one.
author: Bluestarz921

text: Review — I love the Forum aspect of this program helps me to know I am not alone and there are many others out there that are going through the same thing. The daily checklist is awesome works well with accountability and the information information is extremely helpful and useful  I love the ability to be anonymous if I choose too.   The tracker for days on program sleep $ saved is all great.   Has helped me to view this in a different way so that I don’t have to feel ashamed.
author: Smit$y

text: Has potential, needs some work — Perhaps if I were 20 years younger, my review would be a little higher, as I feel like this app is very much geared to a younger audience.   Initially, I found the daily tasks helpful as they focused on the science of why one drinks in excess. As the modules moved more to emotional effects of drinking, it seemed like the advice was very much geared to the 20-30-something crowd. The recovery stories in the daily tasks are all young which is great if you are young, but not relatable as a person who is middle aged and beyond. Also, some of the advice columns offered what seemed to be very pat answers to complex issues - that needs some work.  The forum was great - lots of very supportive people going through the same challenges. I also liked the trackers for the money and calories I was saving by not drinking.   Clearly, this is an app designed by younger people for younger people - and as I said, a younger person battling alcohol dependence will probably find this a useful sobriety tool.
author: DeirdreChristine

text: 1 Year Sober - Life Changing and Life Saving App — I love this app so very much!! I’m not sure if I can add anything more than the other reviews, but this app (and working the ACoA 12 step program) saved my life. I can’t recommend it enough. Initially I got the free trial of the app in November 2021 because of the Instagram ads and figured why not, after a few months of working through the app and some rough holidays I then promised myself I’d do dry January 2022, and now its January 2023 and I’m celebrating a YEAR sober and counting. Thank you for this app!!
author: HuxleyW

text: A fun, authentic way to learn, be inspired + check in with myself daily! — I LOVE reframe! I didn’t join as an epic drinker, but I wanted to learn about how alcohol affects my body + brain. I did the free month, then immediately signed up for the year. I find this such a fun, inspiring, educational way to stay focused on living my best life! I think of Reframe as my mini life coach. I dive deeper myself into some topics + fly through others, but the diversity of topics from health, relationships, mindfulness, self love, psychological concepts - are sooo great to learn about!! Thank you!
author: GemPuddy

text: Lack of app support — The community and the learnings have been life saving without question.  I will be critical of recent changes to the app where the flow of the daily work is being interrupted by disruptive requests for app feedback every single day. Imagine you’re reading a book and as soon as you turn the page, someone comes by and closes the book, gets in you face and won’t give you the book back until you tell them how the last page was.  Every single day. Support has responded “we’re trying to fix it”. This has been going on for months to no avail.
author: HIghlander GM

text: Worth every penny — I rarely write reviews but if someone is looking for resources to help change their relationship with alcohol do try this app. It’s helped me stay alcohol free for 50 days.   You can learn so much about alcohol misuse/dependence through a scientific lens that helps shed the mysticism and shame attached. There are mini actionable suggestions each day that really build up to make a long term difference.  There’s also a sympathetic community moderated by experts and coaches that helps you feel less alone and helpless. I find the meetings to be really helpful, I listen in anonymously (haven’t felt up to share yet but want to one day) and find what people share to be inspiring and empowering. It’s helped me become less judgmental toward myself.  A giant thank you to the developers, you’re making a product that’s truly making a positive difference.
author: Carolin1985

text: ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ — With so many apps out there I took a chance on Reframe and was not disappointed.  As of today I’m 30 days alcohol free and counting. I’m so impressed with the tools the app provides.  The daily tasks, community forums, zoom meetings,tools for meditation, cravings, and science knowledge behind the affects of alcohol.  No judgment within the Reframe community whether your journey is to cut back or go alcohol free.  I’m so happy to find Reframe for my journey to a better healthier lifestyle.  Download this app if you’re serious about changing your lifestyle!
author: Deep & Dope

text: Super Helpful — I’ve found this app super helpful in helping me to be more mindful about my drinking habits. Just stopping to think about it each day is a great way to reframe how you typically drink.   I’ve also learned quite a bit in the month that I’ve used it. I only want to cut back my drinking and this app has been great for that…even when I go over my weekly goal I still appreciate how the app works for me. It doesn’t shame me but rather inspires me to want to do better.  Thank you!
author: Jolbra

text: Ok app, customer service is A.I. — I wanted to completely restart my progress, but the settings to do so do not work.  It restarted me on day one for the lessons, but I still had drinks logged on my calendar, a 3-day streak badge, money saved, etc.  When I tried emailing them I received a timely response telling me to use the settings that I already had tried (and I said that in my email). I tried again, still didn’t work, so I emailed them again and the response I got was exactly word for word the response I had got before. Sorry but if I’m paying $120 a year for your app I expect to be able to communicate with a real person.  Deleted and refunded.
author: j6a6

text: Worth every cent — I initially downloaded Reframe to help me cut back on drinking. After the free trial, I decided to purchased a year subscription. I finished the tasks around 310 days out of 365 and erratically tracked my drinking. After the year was up, I read This Naked Mind by Annie Grace, which is often recommended in the Reframe forum. I decided to cut out alcohol all together 60 days ago and haven’t looked back. This app is the perfect way to start unlearning all the lies about alcohol and will inspire you to go further. Highly recommend!
author: hxi ne zo

text: Super Helpful! — This app has been more helpful than I anticipated.  I signed up for the free trial and decided to purchase the subscription.  It has so many tools to help me on my cutback journey.  What I’ve paid for this app is more than the amount of $ I’ve saved not buying alcohol.  The community using this app is super supportive.  There are optional, free, closed Zoom meetings you can attend throughout the day/evening too.  What you put into this app are the results you will get from it too.  Highly recommend!
author: GoldenGamer_silly

text: Great app! — I signed up for this app because I wanted to decrease my intake of alcohol but didn’t realize the impact it did and continues to have. The education you get about what it does to your body, the tools like meditation and breathing, and the accountability logs have really changed my mindset. The forum is probably my favorite part though. You really feel heard, understood and encouraged. It’s a game changer for me. I think this app would benefit everyone but especially those who want to cut back or quit alcohol all together.

author: A yuh

You’ll save more than that even if you only cut down alcohol use by 2-3 drinks/month! Definitely take part in the forum and the meetings. You’ll discover an amazing family of people who understand exactly what you are going through support you during your successes…and your failures. It is a safe, non-judgmental place where you don’t need to hide anything.
author: Doc DAM

text: Game Changer! — This app, the coaches and community have been an absolute game changer!  The daily tasks, checkin meetings and forum are always helpful, supportive, educational and inspirational. I love this app and community! I also find the tracker of days, dollars and calories a helpful tangible tool. For the first time in more than 20 years, I feel freedom and not in the grips of alcohol. I toggled back & forth between the cutback and quit tracks a couple of times before committing almost 7 months ago to going 100% alcohol free. Best decision ever!
author: CB724

text: Excellent concept — I really struggled with admitting my relationship with alcohol was coming in between myself and my happiness. I felt ashamed, like how did this happen to me? But my coach and the daily exercises have helped me understand the “why” and I am now learning the “how”. I just started this journey and I don’t know where my relationship with alcohol will end up but I know I’ve been able to cut down dramatically and when I do drink I realize more and more, I’m better off without it.
author: Malutang

text: Charging people to help them quit?? — I was very excited to try this app and program. I signed up, filled out the questions, then it told me I would only get a free week trial, and would be $14 per month after that! Are you insane? What the heck is wrong with you? You say you’re trying to help people?? Like 90% of apps are free these days, with upgrades you can pay a little for. I could understand maybe a small one time fee with ads, but $14 a month??!   Talk about taking advantage of people. My gym membership costs less than that and actually provides things to keep me healthy. This could only be an added thing to help. It’s almost entirely up to the individual. What a huge turn off. Especially when one of the things your app claims is that “quitting will save you money... oh but also give us your money too.”   I hadn’t had a drink in a week on my own, and this frustrated me enough that now I don’t really care... hope you feel good about yourself. Completely made me lose my motivation. Not a good look at all... This is actually really disgusting.
author: The Rugg Brothers

text: Life Changing App! — Whether you want to reduce or eliminate drinking, this app is so helpful! You track your progress, check in daily and receive new information that really helps you understand alcohol and motivates you to make whatever changes you want, all in a zero judgement, positive way. You get so much support and so many resources to choose from including optional zoom meetings with other members, meditations, and life courses. Best thing I’ve done for myself in a long time.
author: dacheese

text: Reframing my relationship with alcohol — I started my journey with Reframe on April 1st and in the 60+ days of daily tasks and logging my drinks I have learned so much about myself and my relationship with alcohol in the process. I appreciate the health and wellness topics, the science, and the tone of the articles. It’s a great app and highly recommended. I feel supported and I appreciate that it is not dogmatic. Everyone’s journey is different and the app meets you where you are. I have made positive changes and am just getting started.
author: Dancehall Days

text: 7 days and still satisfy — I knew some of the information on the heath issue my drinking habit could bring me. It’s really good to see all the data in one place and being able to review them in such interactive way. It’s engaging and I feel hope about finally having found a good tool. I tried other apps before but stopped after the first day. It has been a week already on Reframe. Congrats on the team building this platform. I’m Really impressed.
author: Mousou2003

text: Costs money — As bold as it is for me to expect an app to be free when people have put time and effort into it… an ad based version for free would be nice. As an alcoholic trying to quit or lower my drinking, you wont get me to pay an app to help…   I kinda thought/hoped that it might be funded by a non profit or some group just trying to help people. But alas… profit is playing a role here. So I guess I am back to square one. Not their fault, $10 a month isn’t crazy, but someone with a problem will spend that on tonights drinks before they spend it on an app to stop. Shame because it looked well made, but I would only pay for it after it kept me dry for a month or more.
author: gomicao

text: Supportive with info based on science — I’ve been using this app to help me cut back on drinking during the week but it’s worked so well for me that I haven’t needed or wanted a drink in 2 weeks.  It’s given me a new goal of cutting alcohol out for a year.  Some of my favorite things the app offers: - accurate info on how alcohol affects our brains, bodies, etc (I find this more fascinating than reasons why I shouldn’t drink) - no judgement  - realistic advice on ways to choose health over happy hour - realistic goals to strive for  - distraction games and a 20 min timer if I do feel a craving - daily accrued counts on what you’ve gained by not drinking (savings, etc)  I’ve been using it every day for 2 weeks and plan on using it through 2022. I’ve spent 30 years drinking most months/years so I figure I owe it to myself to give it up for one :)
author: yoginijen25

text: Worth Every Penny — I had tried quitting alcohol for 10+ years, unsuccessfully. One day I woke up and had had enough. I decided to find an app for accountability, and found the Reframe app. I downloaded it and have used it every day since- that was 856 days ago. I love paying the annual fee because it’s a good app (good user experience, functionality), made well, and most importantly has 100% helped me quit alcohol with its daily readings, quotes, journaling, community, and tools.
author: meggos18

text: Just what I need! — I heard about the Reframe app on Valerie Bertinelli’s Instagram page. I downloaded the app for the 7 day free trial. I’m so glad I did! I have developed the habit of wine every night, and I know it’s not good for my body. Reframe explains scientific research in easy to understand terms so that we can change our thinking, and reduce or stop our alcohol consumption. I enjoy the short daily readings and tasks that inform and keep me focused. I am now a subscriber, and changing my relationship with alcohol.

The app helps me make mindful choices and manage shame. Love it!
author: CutBackGal

text: Completely worth the subscription; and you’ll feel that before the free trial is up — It feels like this app was my other leg in walking to being alcohol free. After decades of using alcohol to medicate myself (4 drinks/day, every day for the last year has been my peak). I cannot believe that I’m now dealing with life without alcohol.   This app, in my opinion, is an interactive guide with an enormous toolbox. It’s guide and most tools are based on science, not religion (meaning it’s not like AA in this area). You learn the how and why of addiction and alcohol so that you understand what’s happening in your brain, emotions, and body. This was key in creating actual change in thought processes that lead to my drinking.  This app is empowering. I can take what I’ve learned here and translate it into changing virtually any habit I don’t like.   Best app I’ve ever purchased. No question.

author: Sober Pat

text: Useless and cynical — Very low quality app. To the point that I wonder if all the five star reviews are genuine. It's not a useful app: it's more like a normal generic 'streaks' app with an 'alcohol' wrapper to make it feel alcohol-specific. You'd be better off getting a normal, cheaper 'streaks' app to tick off your alcohol-free days if that's what you want. There's nothing 'neurosciency' about it: You get a daily email with some irrelevant, generic 'health' info like 'get more sleep' and 'go to the gym' and platitudes like 'you got this!' The emails are in dark blue against a black background too so they're unreadable, suggesting an indifferent app developer at best. Shallow, one-dimensional, unthought through. Cutting alcohol is a serious mission, and these guys should have been much more serious with this app. As it is it's just a cynical method of extracting subscription money from people who are genuinely looking for a solution. And let's talk about the cost. There are serious, well-researched, well-tested books you can buy that are practically guaranteed to help you cut out or cut down alcohol - books that cost maybe £15 or £20 at most. This app costs several multiples of that. The pricing is out of control, a number plucked from the air. Don't waste your time.

author: mattievalentine

text: Finally something that works! — I’ve been asked to leave a review for the app Reframe, first of all I’d just like to thank the Reframe team for giving me my life back that I lost to alcohol.  So, I’ve tried to stop drinking many time, I’ve never struggled to stop, I’ve never managed to say stopped. Until now.  This app is like no other, my intention was to slowly cut back and follow the reframe app instructions on doing this, what actually happened was I quit instantly without realising it. I finished off a bottle of my favourite tipple then opened up the app, not had a drink since that night. Yes it’s only been 4 weeks as of now but my whole life has changed, I no longer want a drink, and I’ve had all the reasons to have one, like it’s Friday, like I’m going on holiday, that it was my birthday, then my Dads anniversary when he passed away, on top of that my wife drinks daily, believe me any of these situations would have normally led me to saying well I can because of this.  But this app deals in a different way, it keeps you busy, it reminds you just how good it feels not to give in, every day there’s something new, something to keep you guessing what’s next, and this alone keeps your mind in the right direction. I now look forward to getting home and opening the app rather than a bottle. But best of all my wife has seen the changes in me and is now at the beginning of her reframe  journey to sobriety and saying goodbye to her demons that have crept into our marriage.  Reframe I thank you! Kindest regards  David.

text: Success and freedom! — I cannot begin to express how grateful and amazed I am by the Reframe app. This platform has single-handedly transformed my relationship with alcohol, and I can confidently say it has changed my life for the better. With its comprehensive blend of science, support, podcast, and interactive AI tool, Reframe has been the catalyst for my incredible journey from a heavy problem and binge drinker to a more balanced, mindful, and healthy lifestyle. One of the most remarkable aspects of Reframe is the scientific foundation upon which it is built. The app delves deep into the neuroscience of addiction, providing users with valuable insights into the brain's workings when it comes to alcohol consumption. This knowledge is empowering, as it allows you to understand the root causes of your drinking habits and enables you to take control of your actions. The support network within Reframe is second to none. The sense of community that it fosters is truly heartwarming. Connecting with like-minded individuals who have experienced similar struggles has been incredibly therapeutic. Sharing our journeys, triumphs, and setbacks has provided me with a level of understanding and encouragement that I could not have found elsewhere. The Reframe podcast is a gem in itself. It features captivating interviews with experts in the fields of addiction, neuroscience, psychology, and more. Listening to these thought-provoking discussions has not only broadened my understanding of alcohol addiction but has also given me the strength and motivation to continue my journey toward sobriety. One of the app's standout features is its interactive AI support tool. This virtual assistant acts as a personal coach, guiding you through the process of reframing your relationship with alcohol. The AI's non-judgmental approach and its ability to adapt to your progress truly sets it apart from other apps. It feels like having a supportive friend right in your pocket, available whenever you need it. But perhaps the most impressive and life-altering outcome for me has been the significant reduction in my alcohol consumption. Before using Reframe, I was trapped in a cycle of heavy drinking and destructive binge sessions, which often left me with crippling hangovers and regret. However, thanks to Reframe's guidance and encouragement, I now average just 2-3 drinks per week. The transformation is nothing short of astounding, and I haven't experienced a single hangover since I started using the app. I highly recommend Reframe to anyone seeking to reclaim control over their relationship with alcohol. This app goes above and beyond the traditional approaches to tackling addiction, providing a unique and effective blend of science, support, and cutting-edge technology. My life has been forever changed by this remarkable tool, and I can confidently say that Reframe has given me a new lease on life. Thank you, Reframe team, for creating an app that truly makes a difference!

text: Thank you Reframe. — I cannot recommend Reframe highly enough. What makes this app different is that it approaches alcohol habits through science, neuroscience, and education — not shame or guilt. The evidence-based approach genuinely helped me and the way I think/thought about drinking.  I was recently diagnosed with an autoimmune disease, and was told that drinking alcohol was not an option given the medication I would be taking and the dire effects it would have on my health. At first this news terrified me even more than the diagnosis of a potentially fatal disease if left untreated. Wow!! So, I turned to my emails from Reframe for help.   Reframe explains what alcohol actually does to the brain and body in a clear, compassionate, and motivating way.  I especially appreciated that Reframe focuses on progress, awareness, and healthier habits instead of perfection and this was just the tool I needed to move forward and get past the fact that drinking alcohol could no longer be a part of my everyday life.   If you too are  wanting to cut back, or stop completely like I have and are looking to build a healthier relationship with alcohol, I truly think Reframe is for you.  Their science-based approach and supportive guidance made a real difference for me, and the emails alone were worth it. Everything I read allowed me to be able to put a tick in the box with why and how I was feeling. Why I was feeling so good mentally and physically. It all started to make sense.   I feel like a “new”  me. The old me before I made alcohol my “go too”.    I will continue to read their work, their research and stories. I will be forever grateful to them.   Thank you reframe team  you are amazing  🤩

text: Highly recommended. Educational, practical and motivational — I’ve used it off and on for a couple of years, but this year I committed to making it a daily habit, and it’s been a game changer for me. The beauty of it is that it only takes about 5 minutes each day.  Each morning, I start with a little education on various topics, including alcohol awareness, how the brain functions, goal setting, and motivation, among others. For me, learning about alcohol has been especially vital—it empowers me to make more informed choices about drinking.  The app also encourages easy personal reflections with short check-ins on my stress levels, mood, and mental health. This helps me stay aware of how I’m feeling and understand my triggers better, allowing me to navigate through lower moods and stressful times with greater acceptance.  One of my favorite features is the drink logging. I’m currently just shy of 5 months without a drink, and I feel so much healthier both physically and mentally. While I wouldn’t say my success is solely due to the app, I consider it one of the important strategies that has supported me on this journey, and I’m truly grateful for it.  I also enjoy using some of the meditations regularly to kick off my workday and boost my self-esteem. They are a great addition to my routine.  There are aspects of the app I haven’t explored yet, but I love that there’s something for everyone who is looking to cut back or quit drinking altogether.  Five months ago, I made a firm decision not to drink again. I realized that willpower alone wouldn’t get me there; I needed to recalibrate my thinking and reframe my mindset to the point where I simply didn’t want to drink.  This app has been an essential tool in that process. I now have a significantly better understanding of how alcohol works and its effects. I’ve gained more tools to manage stress and build a fulfilling life.  As a result, the choice to drink or not rarely comes into question for me anymore. I’ve truly reframed my thinking—I just don’t drink. The Reframe app has played a significant role in that transformation.

text: Tremendous Impact — Reframe has made a tremendous impact on my life. It has given me structure and support from the community of Reframers. I have learned so much from the daily check-in's and lessons. I have benefitted from the shame-free approach and continue to improve.
author: David

text: Reframe is saving my life. — Reframe is saving my life. It’s where you can find a truly supportive and judgement free community (the reframbly)! I’ll keep renewing every year.
author: Lauren Morris

text: I signed up for the $49.99 every 3… — I signed up for the $49.99 every 3 months deal. I also signed up for a couple add-ons at $19.99 each. I don't even remember what those were for but I don't think whatever it was I paid for that I'm getting. but what's really appalling to me as I jumped into a meeting and I it was my fourth meeting. the first three were okay one of them was amazing. but right from the get-go this meeting became about hating white men and then the chat was negative the comments were negative it just became this evil nasty divisive bigoted disgusting thing. and let me tell you they're a little zoom is not easy to navigate and I was subjected to way too much of that while I was trying to figure out how to turn that dang meeting off. the chat was negative the video is negative and the coach says to this girl oh you and I could be friends and so that told me where her heart was. that she embraced all that negative horrible diarrhea spewing from that woman's mouth right from the beginning and that set the tone for the entire meeting. I don't want to single dime of mine going towards that kind of hate and racism. I have sent an email to support. and I'll probably have to end up trying to go through my credit card to get my money back. but I'm not supporting racism and sexism under the guise of healthcare. nope
author: Maria Nash

text: Daylight robbery and horrendous customer services  — Absolutely shocking, stay clear. I signed up on their website paying £25. Got the receipt through. Then the website sent me to download the App. I did this and  entered my details and it asked me to pay even more after going through all the questions again. Iv emailed them 3 times with no response. So im now in the process of going through UK consumer rights to claim my money back as on their website you can't get refunds, but I havent even had any sort of service as I can't access a account
author: james bassett

text: Reframe is great if you want to QUIT… — Reframe is great if you want to QUIT alcohol. I found that the guidance for wanting to cut back seemed odd as they were  coaching tips from folks that had two DUIs. I just really was thinking that that app would suggest tips and tricks from individuals who had similar experiences or goals. If you are looking for something to cut back on the glass of wine per night it’s not really set up for those people despite saying it’s for cutting back. It really is geared for quitting only. Also I found the number of check ins to be a lot. I was at the minimum amount and it was still 15 mins a day at various intervals.
author: Heather MacDonald

text: REFRAME is a Great Mate to have! — The best part about Reframe is that it's not the slightest bit "judgy". It also SUGGESTS "reduction" rather than abstinence. I haven't had a drink for 6 months and I am enjoying my life without the "other guy" (my booze habit) around all the time. THANKS REFRAME!
author: Paul

text: Changed my mind - literally — Initially I had difficulty logging onto the site - which caused me to write a 1 * review...but I have to say now I am consuming the content my views have changed.  Its a thought-provoking and supportive app which has already helped to  alter my drinking habits just a few days in.  It is analytical so it appeals to the way my brain works. It is an American app - so the pull is pretty global.  I would recommend.  My only concern is ongoing cost - I have not bought any extras and paid for 3 months.  It is not clear how to unsubscribe and something I need to find out.
author: Sally Manser

text: I saw quite a few ads for Reframe on… — I saw quite a few ads for Reframe on social media which really caught my attention in regards to my excessive alcohol consumption.  I decided to try the app for 30 days for free and have not only enjoyed using the app but have remained alcohol free now for 28 days.  I thought I wanted to just drink less but the education about what harmful things that I’m doing to my mind and body convinced me to remain totally alcohol free.  Contained within the app are tons of daily informational topics, discussion forums, zoom meeting links, videos, journaling. The beauty of it is that you can choose to do the activities that work for you and ignore the rest.  I’ve never had any billing problems, I’ve been charged exactly as advertised.  I’ve had one glitch involving a small forum group that I participate in but the 3 times that I’ve submitted a help case for this minor issue I’ve gotten a personalized response within hours.  I’ve raved about the app to my wife and others.  It’s so much more than just an app, it is a connection with real people who are all in the same boat, that boat being an unhealthy relationship with alcohol.  It’s really a community connection tool.  The cost is reasonable and I feel absolutely safe talking with the other Reframe members and coaches.  One final comment.  I feel so much better today than I did 28 days ago mentally, physically, and spiritually.  I will definitely be upping my subscription to the annual plan.  I wish I had tried this sooner!!
author: Trip Farris

text: I love Reframe, zero billing or subscription issues  — I love Reframe. It's made it possible for me to go alcohol free. The Coaches, meetings, and community are beyond what I hoped for. I signed up for 6 Mos. for 69.99.renewable after that. I've had 0 issues with the subscription or billing.
author: Susan

text: Who knew this app could be so wonderful  — Love this app.  The price of an annual subscription is worth it.  I have learned so much about the brain connection to addiction.  Great community.   Love the coaches and meetings.  My journey has just started and I see myself starting to enjoy life for the first time because of reframe.
author: Heidi Winter

text: THANK YOU REFRAME for helping make my life more manageable and healthier  — I came to Reframe a few years ago on a cutback journey that turned AF with the help of the app. Then, I took a break until this year. Since then, they have upgraded the app and added SO many improvements with valuable AI tools etc. I now frequently attend a wide variety of live meetings with professional coaches and find that they along with the friendly community reinforce my newly embraced long term alcohol free lifestyle. I adore the Creatives, Habits Weekly, Healthy Strategies and Neurodivergence meetings and Speaker Shares along with the forum and monthly challenges! Too bad I didn’t utilize the app as much the first time I joined and stuck with the it or I probably would have avoided the current DUI situation I am facing. Being able to wake up and turn on meetings in my pocket with my phone and ear buds and find my people along with personable coaching and effective tools for cravings is absolutely priceless to me🙏🦋🌱🌸🕊️💕🧠⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
author: Consumer

text: Reframe really helped me become alcohol… — Reframe really helped me become alcohol free. There are so many resources, from daily readings, monthly challenges, online journaling with prompts, a drink tracker, an active forum, videos, book reviews, small user led groups, courses, zoom meetings, etc. The community is phenomenal and the support and encouragement are amazing. I got way more than I expected when I signed up for Reframe.
author: MEG

text: Reframe found me! — Reframe is bringing me to where I want to be regarding alcohol. No judgement. No judgement. No judgement.   The app, the meetings and the coaches, are just what I needed.
author: Mary

text: Ripped off.. — Ripped off... signed up for 7 day trial.  Charged $79 immediately.  App isn't worth 79¢.  Advertise that it's to cut down, but in reality just the same old "demon rum" philosophy dressed up with a lot of pseudoscience.  The forums, comments etc. are all about "alcohol free", not cutting back or "getting your edge back".  Heavily moderated and always trying to sell additional "services", coaching etc.  I'd give it a zero if I could.  Got to better free apps out there that don't preach the AA mantras
author: raynjuls KS

text: Very poor experience — Key features stopped working after a few months. Got ZERO support. Interface is very cluttered, science questionable, and full of additional costs and ads to get you to buy more content, even with a paid subscription. Sunnyside is MUCH better. Stay away from this one.   Edit to add after app reply: you got numerous occasions to "make this better". I reported the issue almost a month ago and just got what seems to be an automated reply asking me to provide more details, which I did, with no results. I lost hope at this point, which is why I submitted this review.
author: Michele

text: Reframe Med+ Medication cancelation - very difficult — I had signed up to try a medication that they recommended. The medication did not work for me and when I asked to have any future shipments canceled I was given the run around. After MANY emails and calls to the support team it was finally handled. In the process I was given bad information and blamed for the fact that their customer support person did not understand my request. Horrible experience.
author: Linda Young

text: SCAM!!! — SCAM!!!! Signed up for £4.99 starter and have just been told by my wife they’ve been taking £40 a month! Should have checked my bank statements. This is the cost of a gym membership for giving you an article you could get from the internet for free, a vague sentence quote, and a set of fireworks when you tell them you didn’t drink. Avoid like the plague. Absolutely livid about this.
author: Saadet mcadoo

text: If I could give 0 stars I would — If I could give 0 stars I would. They are quick to take your money without results. I signed up for a 7 day “trial” next I knew they had deducted $200 from my account without any warning or authorisation. My emails to them about this were not replied to. I will not be signing up again. Can’t wait for subscription to end. Disgusting customer service
author: Gail Clark

text: Disappointed.   — When I signed up I had great difficulty in logging in which was never resolved despite emails from me.  Then when I tried to cancel and get a refund it was a slow and painful process.  I would receive gushy emails but no action on cancelling and refunding.   Eventually I did get my money back.  The program looks good but I was disappointed with my experience.
author: Hamish Barker

text: Charged £99.99 for a £4.99 trial — Signed up for what I thought was a month trial for £4.99, I’ve been charged £99.99. Tried contacting them via email and instagram and have had no reply. I think it’s a good app but the customer service and the issue with payment is appalling. Sadly I won’t be recommending this app anyone. I would really appreciate a response to my contact attempts.
author: Georgia Grant

text: disgraceful customer service — Despite writing FIVE times in 7 days to the email address support@, I have had no response.  I signed up for the free trial but after a few days decided the app wasn't for me.  I was expecting a notification to say that a payment was needed which would then remind me to cancel.  Appalling customer service.
author: Sarah Nayar

text: Scammed out of $68 — I signed up for 3 months at a cost of $49, plus a $19 fee for 'extra support. The charges hit my bank account immediately. But I did not receive a confirmation or access to the app. Nothing! I've contacted customer service several times. I was advised to download the app, which I did, but the app won't work until I pay. The app is offering $49 for a full year....1/4 of what I paid. And, I keep getting emails from the app with even better pricing. Customer Service has not been ant help. It's a total scam. They took $68 from me and I got nothing in return.
author: MisFitz

text: I wish I had read reviews about unfair… — I wish I had read reviews about unfair charging. I signed up for what I had seen was a £4.99 subscription, and did not see anywhere that this would quickly turn into a £100 upfront charge. I was absolutely shocked when I received this charge on Christmas Eve. I haven’t found the app useful and was not using it. I immediately asked for a refund from Apple who refused and reframe said they want to help but to contact Apple, who won’t help. I am devastated at losing this money and having zero ways to appeal. I have since seen numerous reviews of similar experiences. I am considering discussing this as a fraudulent charge with my credit card company as it’s completely not on.
author: MEGAN OTT

text: Life-changing support when I needed it most! — I’ve been using Reframe for almost a month and it has honestly been the kindest, most effective tool I’ve ever tried. The daily neuroscience-based readings are short but eye-opening, the community forum feels like a safe little corner of the internet, and the live meetings (even if I don’t feel brave enough to turn my camera on and share) have been pure gold. I love that nobody is judged and there is so much compassion. What surprised me most is how much I look forward to opening the app every day, it’s become my calm little ritual alongside my morning coffee :) If you’re even thinking about changing your relationship with alcohol, just try it. This app doesn’t shout at you; it just gently hands you the tools and the support and lets you find your own way. I’m so grateful I found Reframe!
author: Marcy me

text: Brilliant resource, effective and easy to use — Brilliant resource that has taught me a lot about my relationship with alcohol. Lots of handy tips and a great guide if you want to cut down or quit completely.  Easy to use and judgement free.  An up to date way to navigate healthier choices.
author: Anna Payne

text: I’m alive and here for my family because of this app  — I’m sad others have had difficulty cancelling after the free trial ended but can’t speak to that as I definitely wanted to keep the subscription going. I’ve only had good experiences with tech support who have fixed issues for me when I’ve had them (only a couple of times in 11 months).  I was at a ‘do or die’ point in my life. I searched for an app to help me keep track of how much I had been drinking so I could safely cut back and found an app that gave me so much more. Withdrawal symptoms were hard and scary but Reframe gave me information, support & reassurance.   With Reframe there is no judgement about where we are at in our life, just a huge variety of tools and resources and the best thing (which I never thought I would do because of guilt and shame and a crippling social anxiety) is that it has given me access to a community of other people who hold one another up. I can chose to do this or not, it fits in to my pocket and it slots in to any spare moment I have in my day. If the timing works, I listen in or participate in a zoom meeting hosted by a highly qualified coach (there are multiple meetings every day) with camera off or on, using a pseudonym or real name. I’ve even now used the chat function and spoken in meetings which was a huge deal for me. I can post and reply in the forum. Within months I was chatting in a small chat group of people with very similar experiences to me and we keep in touch.   AA wasn’t for me. With Reframe I don’t have to go to in person meetings with people on a very particular path. I have access to articles, podcasts, courses, all on the basic subscription - I can chose to pay extra for 1:1 coaching but I haven’t done that, other reframers say it has been very useful.   In just 11 months I have gone from hell to hope, my liver has recovered (WOW) at time of writing this review I have saved $4k by not buying alcohol and lost 15kg.  My kids have a mum again. They are so proud of me and the best thing ever is feeling their hugs and love. Alcohol ruined my life. Reframe gave my life back to me.   My favourite quote I heard through a reframer when I was on the fence about fighting alcohol use:   “The work is hard, staying drunk is hard.  Chose your hard.”  Thanks Reframe, you're making the hard so much easier.
author: Shona

text: Reframe saved my life — Did the 1 month trial membership, reasoning it was the same cost as one cheap bottle of wine and if it helped me not drink for even one day of that month it would have paid for itself. Fast forward 14 months and change and I haven't had a drink in 423 days. The daily 'tasks' that teach you what alcohol does to your body are enlightening and motivating in themselves, and the zoom meetings lead by some pretty amazing coaches are invaluable. Without this app I'd still be in a very dark place drinking 2+ bottles of wine every night on my way to diabetes and/or liver failure and/or dementia. The $150 CDN subscription has saved me over $9,000 in alcohol purchases. I've also made friendships in the meetings and on the app that will last a lifetime. 10/10 recommend this app to anybody who isn't comfortable with or is questioning the way they drink.
author: Court B

text: Scam scam scam!!! — Scam scam scam!!!! Did a quiz and they charged me when I added PayPal details but they charged my bank direct, but I cancelled before any confirmation. Thankfully I reported fraud to my bank and they refunded me
author: Olivia

text: Several Trustpilot reviewers report… — Several Trustpilot reviewers report unwanted subscription renewals and difficulty cancelling. Some describe charges they didn’t authorise as unethical or deceptive - I have similar experience. I regret signing up. I should’ve check the reviews first.
author: Shimon Konatowicz

text: Reframe is just another scam — Reframe is just another scam. I signed up for one month, thinking I would try it, and then they charged me for a year. Apple support says I’m not eligible for a refund. Guess I can kiss $100 goodbye. Another website that just wants your money.

text: Oh why didn't I read the reviews — Oh why didn't I read the reviews - I paid for a half-yearly subscription, recieved no confirmation and no password to allow access to the app so I have just given over £50 to scammers.  My own fault - all the things I've read about not answering ads on fb or instagram and I've been caught. It's so easy.  I have been trying to sort this out with (rubbish) customer services for several days - just keep getting the same generic replies.  You live and learn
author: Susan

text: The app is really working well for me — The app is really working well for me. Before signing up I thought about what I needed and what my expectations were and reviewed my options. I chose reframe and finding it really helpful. The daily tasks are quick useful reminders to help achieve my goals and the meetings a really helpful reminder that I am not doing this alone.
author: Consumer

text: Total waste of time and $ and offered… — Total waste of time and $ and offered nothing useful. People sign up for these things because they really need help & this does the opposite.
author: Sean

text: It worked for me. Great value for money.  — It is not exactly fair that in order to write an anonymous review on trustpilot you need to change your whole username on your account and it still may not appear as exactly anonymous, which I suspect is the reason for the shockingly low number of positive reviews for Reframe. This is an app for moderating or quitting alcohol so a lot of people who use it prefer to remain anonymous. I’ve had only positive experience with the app, i cannot believe the value you get for the money you pay, there are so many resources available including live meditations and meetings, even on holidays. All coaches I have encountered are non- judgmental, knowledgeable, compassionate, professional and dedicated. I have tried numerous other methods available and only reframe helped me achieve my goals. I think the format of the app is great and it really works.
author: Marta

text: Not recommended at all — Not recommended at all, bogus claims and questionable ethics.
author: steve shadforth

text: BEWARE SCAM… — Like many others here I signed up for the free trial, realised it wasn't what I was looking for and cancelled immediately. I realized a few days later they had charged me for the full year. I've sent countless emails to which they reply that the refund has been processed their end. It's been over a month and I've yet to get my money back. This is a disgusting scam. Stay away.
author: Dynamic Panda

text: Don’t do it — Don’t do it. The app is patronising, judgemental and very heterosexual oriented. It’s also very targeted towards Americans. I didn’t learn anything new from this app other than being and feeling judged. The limits you set are not monitored, there’s no encourage t and the app looks at selling other products to you. If you’re looking to give up alcohol do it yourself as I did after 8 weeks trying unsuccessfully with reframe. 8 weeks after using the app I’m alcohol free with no need for their homophobic ‘lessons’ and judgement of behaviour
author: Chris

text: I had to write a review on Reframe… — I had to write a review on Reframe after reading all the negative reviews on here.  I have been on Reframe for just over 200 days and sober for the same amount of time.    The app, the community within it and the coaches have been nothing short of incredible.  They are the reason I have remained (happily sober) all this time.  I have tried to get sober for over 10 years and this time it's sticking.  The fee doesn't even come close to reflecting it's worth.  Imagine how much you spend on alcohol, therapists or even rehab?  There are many Reframe users on the app who have failed with conventional rehab and found Reframe to be more successful.  Some people have done a mix of different therapies and found that useful.  All is accepted on Reframe.  You are not shamed for slip ups, that's all part of the journey.   I have even given up smoking and other substances with the support of Reframe.    I have felt supported by the community and coaches and empowered by the knowledge of how the brain gets hijacked by alcohol.  I have learnt so much about myself and why I drank.  It's not just about quitting alcohol. It's about the human condition and for this knowledge and the confidence it has given me I am truly grateful.  The online zoom meetings are a game changer.   I urge anyone with alcohol abuse issues to try Reframe, even if it's for a month.  I know now that I will never question the decision to stop drinking.  Thanks Reframe for changing my life.
author: Mazza

text: Scammy sales tactics, steer well clear — At best unethical, have reported them for mis-selling. Promote free or low cost trials but proceed to levy a full year’s charge. Refer you to Apple for cancellation/refund though clearly there is something amiss in this process as Apple simply reject the request (not been the case where I’ve had lesser issues with other app subs in the past). As others have said Reframe then offer an arbitrary 50% refund. Easy money for them! Currently looking into official routes to complain given this is evidently a common behaviour. Shame as the app is actually ok, but do yourself a favour and avoid the people selling it at all costs.  UPDATE: They have replied to this review after over a year giving me a route to raise concerns. Which says a lot. Having experienced their customer service at length already I shan’t waste my time on it further, so I’ll just stick by the review above.
author: Andy

text: SCAM  — Do NOT give this company money they are a complete scam. I signed up for a free trial and was charged for a years subscription the same day. I reached out to them and even offered to pay for a month instead of the full year, that it was clearly a mistake. They first refused, then offered a refund if I logged in every day for 60 days - then finally offered me 50% off, all of which is completely unacceptable since I signed up for what was advertised as a free trial. They are predatory, and it particularly unsettling that they prey on people during a vulnerable time and exploit their looking for community, support, and help. DISGUSTING.
author: Taya Kenny

text: Useless app. Scammy people.  — The app is too much and overall useless. All the “psychology” behind it is simply repetitive. You can get a free drink tracking app to do the job. In addition, the people behind it are simply trying to trick you into a subscription by getting you to sign up outside of the App Store, then lie to you that you didn’t cancel. Stay away.
